text_iast: triḥphalīkṛtāṃs taṇḍulān trir devebhyaḥ prakṣālayed ity āhur dvir manuṣyebhyaḥ sakṛt pitṛbhya iti
translation: After the grain has three times been winnowed, he should wash it thrice (if it is destined) for the gods, they say, twice, if for men, once, if for the Fathers.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*6] Having put a (Darbha) purifier (into the pot in which the oblation is to be prepared), he should pour the grain (into it).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When it has been cooked, he should sprinkle (Agya) on it, should take it from the fire towards the north, and should again sprinkle (Agya) on it.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agnim upasamādhāya kuśaiḥ samantaṃ paristṛṇuyāt purastāddakṣiṇata uttarataḥ paścād iti
translation: Having put wood on the fire, he should strew Kusa grass round it on all sides, to the east, to the south, to the north, to the west--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*10] On all sides in three layers or in five layers--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*11] Thick, so that always an uneven number (of blades) are put together.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (He should strew) eastward-pointed grass, covering the roots with the points.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: paścād vāstīrya dakṣiṇataḥ prāñcaṃ prakarṣati tathottareṇa
translation: [*13] Or he should strew it to the west (of the fire), and should draw (some of the grass which he has strewn) from the south end and (some) from the north end, in an easterly direction.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He should (arrange the grass so as to) lay the points of the southern blades uppermost.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: This rule for strewing (grass) round (the fire is valid) for all (ceremonies) at which oblations are made.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: paridhīn apy eke kurvanti śāmīlān pārṇān vā
translation: [*16] Some lay also branches of Sami wood or of Parna wood round (the fire).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To the north (of the fire) a Sruva full of water (is placed): this is the Pranita water;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: bhave na vā syād ity eke
translation: If there is (such water). Or it may be dispensed with, say some (teachers).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sarpis tailaṃ dadhi payo yavāgūm vā
translation: [*20] (He may take) ghee, or oil made from Tila seeds, or curds, or milk, or rice gruel.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tata eva barhiṣaḥ prādeśamātre pavitre kurute
translation: [*21] From that same Barhis (he takes two Darbha blades and) makes purifiers (of them), of the length of one span.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: oṣadhim antardhāya chinatti na nakhena pavitre stho vaiṣṇavyāviti
translation: Putting an herb between (them and the instrument with which he cuts them), he cuts them off, not with his nail, with (the words), 'Purifiers are ye, sacred to Vishnu.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: athaine adbhir anumārṣṭi viṣṇor manasā pūte stha iti
translation: He then wipes them with water, with (the words), 'By Vishnu's mind ye are purified.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*24] Having purified (the Agya by pouring it into the Agya pot, over which he has laid a Darbha purifier), he purifies it (in the pot) with the two northward-pointed purifiers (in the following way):
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ copakaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ cāṅgulibhyām abhisaṃgṛhya prākśas trir utpunāti devas tvā savitotpunātv acchidreṇa pavitreṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhir iti sakṛd yajuṣā dvis tūṣṇīm
translation: Holding them with his two thumbs and fourth fingers, he purifies (the Agya) three times, from west to east, once with the Yagus: 'May the god Savitri purify thee with this uninjured purifier, with the rays of the good sun;' twice silently.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He then should sprinkle them with water and should throw them into the fire.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Then, having put that Agya on the fire, he should take it from (the fire) towards the north.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: This is the way to prepare the Agya.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*1] Under a propitious Nakshatra let him take a wife--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*2] Who should possess the auspicious characteristics in due way.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: If he can find no such (woman, he should take) earth-clods--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vedyāḥ sītāyā hradād goṣṭhāc catuṣpathād ādevanād ādahanād iriṇāt
translation: [*4] From an altar, a furrow, a pool, a cow-stable, a place where four roads meet, a gambling-place, a place where corpses are burnt, and from sterile soil;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A ninth (earth-clod) mixed of all.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (These he should make) equal (and should) make marks at them.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pāṇāv ādhāya kumāryā upanāmayed ṛtam eva prathamam ṛtam nātyeti kaścanarta iyaṃ pṛthivī śritā sarvam idam asau bhūyād iti tasyā nāma gṛhītvaiṣām ekaṃ gṛhāṇeti brūyāt
translation: [*7] Taking them in his hand he should offer them to the girl, and (reciting the formula): 'Right alone is the first; right nobody oversteps; on right this earth is founded. May N.N. become this universe!'--he should pronounce her name and should say: 'Take one of these.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: If she takes one of the first four (clods), he should marry her,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*9] And according to some (teachers) also, if (she takes) the mixed one.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: klītakair yavair māṣair vāplutāṃ suhṛt surottamena saśarīrāṃ trir mūrdhany abhiṣiñcet kāma veda te nāma mado nāmāsīti samānayāmum iti patināma gṛhṇīyāt svāhākārāntābhir upastham uttarābhyāṃ plāvayet
translation: [*10] After she has been washed with Klitaka, barley and beans, a friend should besprinkle her three times at her head, so that her whole body becomes wet, with Sura of first quality, with (the formula), 'Kama! I know thy name. Intoxication thou art by name,' &c. (Mantra-Brahmana I, 1, 2). (In the passage of the formula), 'Bring hither N.N.,' he should pronounce the husband's name. (The Mantras should have) the word Svaha at their end. With the two following verses he should wash her private parts.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: That has to be done by (female) relatives (of the bride).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha janyānām eko dhruvāṇām apāṃ kalaśaṃ pūrayitvā sahodakumbhaḥ prāvṛto vāgyato 'greṇāgniṃ parikramya dakṣiṇata udaṅmukho 'vatiṣṭhate
translation: [*13] Then one of the people who assist at the wedding, fills a cup with 'firm' water, and having walked with the water-pot round the fire on its front side, silent, wrapped in his robe, he stations himself to the south (of the fire), facing the north.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Another person with a goad (walks in the same way and stations himself in the same place).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: śamīpalāśamiśrāṃś ca lājāṃś caturañjalimātrāñchūrpeṇopasādayanti paścād agneḥ
translation: They place roasted grain mixed with Sami leaves, to the amount of four handfuls, in a winnowing basket behind the fire,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And an upper mill-stone.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha yasyāḥ pāṇiṃ grahīṣyan bhavati saśiraskā sāplutā bhavati
translation: [*17] Now (the girl) whose hand he is going to seize, has been washed, (her whole body) including her head.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ahatena vasanena patiḥ paridadhyād yā akṛntann ity etayarcā paridhatta dhatta vāsaseti ca
translation: The husband should put on her a (new) garment which has not yet been washed, with the verse, 'They who spun' (Mantra-Brahmana I, 1, 5), and with (the verse), 'Put on her, dress her' (l.l. 6).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prāvṛtāṃ yajñopavītinīm abhyudānayan japet somo 'dadad gandharvāyeti
translation: Leading forward (from the house to the sacred fire, the bride) who is wrapped in her robe and wears the sacrificial cord over her left shoulder, he should murmur (the verse), 'Soma gave her to the Gandharva' (MB. I, 1, 7).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: paścād agneḥ saṃveṣṭitaṃ kaṭam evaṃjātīyaṃ vānyat padā pravartayantīṃ vācayet pra me patiyānaḥ panthāḥ kalpatām iti
translation: [*20] While she, to the west of the fire, pushes forward with her foot a rush-mat or something else of that kind, veiled (with clothes), he should make her say: 'May the way which my husband goes, be open to me.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: If she does not murmur (these words out of shame, &c.), he should murmur (them, saying), 'To her' (instead of 'To me').
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: She should make the end of the rush-mat (Sutra 20) reach the end of the Barhis.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: On the east end of the rush-mat she sits down to the right of the bridegroom.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: dakṣiṇena pāṇinā dakṣiṇam aṃsam anvārabdhāyāḥ ṣaḍ ājyāhutīr juhoty agnir etu prathama ity etatprabhṛtibhiḥ
translation: [*24] While she touches his right shoulder with her right hand, he sacrifices six oblations of Agya with (the verse), 'May Agni go as the first,' and the following (verses) (MB. I, 1, 9-14)--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And (three oblations) with the Mahavyahritis, one by one;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A fourth with (the four Mahavyahritis) together.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*1] After the sacrifice they both arise.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: anupṛṣṭhaṃ patiḥ parikramya dakṣiṇata udaṅmukho 'vatiṣṭhate vadhvañjaliṃ gṛhītvā
translation: The husband passes behind her back, stations himself to the south, with his face turned to the north, and seizes the woman's joined hands.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pūrvā mātā lājān ādāya bhrātā vā vadhūm ākrāmayed aśmānaṃ dakṣiṇena prapadena
translation: [*3] (Standing) to the east (of the girl) her mother or her brother, having taken the roasted grain, should make the bride tread on the stone with the tip of her right foot.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The bridegroom murmurs: 'Tread on this stone' (MB. I, 2, 1).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Her brother filling once his joined hands with roasted grain, pours it into the bride's joined hands.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: taṃ sopastīrṇābhighāritam agnau juhoty avicchindaty añjalim iyaṃ nāry upabrūta iti
translation: [*6] After (Agya) has been spread under and poured over (the fried grain), she sacrifices that in the fire without opening her joined hands, with (the verse which the bridegroom [?] recites), 'This woman says' (MB. I, 2, 2).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: aryamaṇaṃ nu devaṃ pūṣaṇam ity uttarayoḥ
translation: [*7] (The verses), 'The god Aryaman,' and, 'Pushan' (l.l. 3. 4) (are repeated) at the two following (oblations of fried grain).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: hute patir yathetaṃ parivrajya pradakṣiṇam agniṃ pariṇayati mantravān vā brāhmaṇaḥ kanyalā pitṛbhya iti
translation: [*8] After that sacrifice the husband, passing (behind her back), returns in the same way, and leads her round the fire so that their right sides are turned towards it, or a Brahmana versed in the Mantras (does the same), with (the verse), 'The maid from the fathers' (MB. I, 2, 5).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pariṇītā tathaivāvatiṣṭhate tathākrāmati tathā japati tathāvapati tathā juhoti
translation: After she has thus been lead round, she stands as before (Sutras 1. 2), and treads (on the stone) as before (Sutra 3), and he murmurs the (Mantra) as before (Sutra 4), and (her brother) pours (the fried grain into her hands) as before (Sutra 5), and she sacrifices as before (Sutra 6).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the same way three times.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: śūrpeṇa śeṣam agnāv opya prāgudīcīm abhyutkrāmayanty ekam iṣa iti
translation: After (she) has poured the remnants (of the fried grain) into the fire, they make (her) step forward in a north-easterly direction with (the formula), 'For sap with one step' (MB. I, 2, 6. 7).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: She should put forward her right foot (first) and should follow with the left.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The bridegroom) should say (to her), 'Do not put the left (foot) before the right.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: īkṣakān pratimantrayeta sumaṅgalīr iyaṃ vadhūr iti
translation: [*14] The lookers-on he should address with (the verse), 'Auspicious ornaments wears this woman' (I. 1. 8).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: apareṇāgnim audako 'nusaṃvrajya pāṇigrāham mūrdhadeśe 'vasiñcati tathetarāṃ samañjantv ity etayarcā
translation: [*15] To the west of the fire the water-carrier follows (their way) and besprinkles the bridegroom on his forehead, and also the other one (i.e. the bride), with this verse (which the bridegroom murmurs), 'May (the Visve devas) anoint (or, unite)' (l.l. 9).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When (these verses) are finished, they carry her away--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yānam ārohantyāṃ sukiṃśukaṃ śalmalim ity etām ṛcaṃ japet
translation: When she mounts the chariot, let him murmur the verse, 'Adorned with Kimsuka flowers, of Salmali wood' (MB. I, 3, 11).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: akṣabhaṅge naddhavimokṣe yānaviparyāse 'nyāsu cāpatsu yam evāgniṃ haranti tam evopasamādhāya vyāhṛtibhir hutvānyaddravyam āhṛtya ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣa ity ājyaśeṣenābhyañjet
translation: [*3] If the axle breaks, or something that is bound gets loose, or if the chariot is overturned, or if some other accident happens, they should put wood on the fire which they carry with themselves, should make oblations (of Agya) with the Vyahritis, should procure a new piece (instead of that which has been damaged), and should besmear it with the remnants of the Agya (that has been offered), with (the verse), 'He who without binding' (Sama-veda I, 244).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Having sung the Vamadevya, he should mount (again).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When they have arrived, the Vamadevya (is sung).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: gṛhagatāṃ patiputraśīlasampannā brāhmaṇyo 'varopyānaḍuhe carmaṇy upaveśayantīha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvam iti
translation: When (the bride) has reached the house, Brahmana women of good character, whose husbands and sons are living, make her descend (from the chariot), and make her sit down on a bull's hide with (the verse which the husband recites), 'Here, ye cows, bring forth calves' (MB. I, 3, 13).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: They should place a boy in her lap.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*8] Into the joined hands of that (boy) they should throw lotus-roots (?),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or fruits.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: utthāpya kumāraṃ dhruvā ājyāhutīr juhoty aṣṭāv iha dhṛtir iti
translation: [*10] After she has made that boy rise, she sacrifices the eight 'firm' Agya oblations with (the formula), 'Here is steadiness' (MB. I, 3, 14).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: samāptāsu samidham ādhāya yathāvayasaṃ gurūn gotreṇābhivadya yathārtham
translation: When she has finished, she puts a piece of wood (on the fire) and respectfully salutes the Gurus, according to seniority, with their Gotra names. Then they may do what they like.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prātaḥ saśiraskāplutodagagreṣu darbheṣu paścād agner udagagreṣu darbheṣu prācy upaviśati
translation: In the morning, after she has been washed, sitting on northward-pointed Darbha grass, (all over her body) including her head, she sits down to the west of the fire on northward-pointed Darbha grass, facing the east.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: paścāt patir avasthāya dakṣiṇena pāṇinā dakṣiṇam aṃsam anvavamṛśyānantarhitaṃ nābhideśam abhimṛśet pumāṃsau mitrāvaruṇāvityetayarcā
translation: Her husband, standing behind her, should grasp down with his right hand over her right shoulder, and should touch the uncovered place of her navel with the verse, 'The two men, Mitra and Varuna' (MB. I, 4, 8).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Then they may do what they like.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Then afterwards (the following ceremony should be performed).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prāgudīcyāṃ diśi nyagrodhaśuṅgām ubhayataḥphalām asrāmām akṛmiparisṛptāṃ triḥsaptair yavair māṣair vā parikrīyotthāpayet
translation: In a north-easterly direction, having bought for three times seven barley corns or beans a Nyagrodha shoot which. has fruits on both sides, which is not dry and not touched by worms, he should set that up.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yadyasi saumī somāya tvā rājñe parikrīṇāmi yady asi vāruṇī varuṇāya tvā rājñe parikrīṇāmi yady asi vasubhyo vasubhyas tvā parikrīṇāmi yadyasi rudrebhyo rudrebhyastvā parikrīṇāmi yady asy ādityebhya ādityebhyastvā parikrīṇāmi yady asi marudbhyo marudbhyas tvā parikrīṇāmi yadyasi viśvebhyo devebhyo viśvebhyas tvā devebhyaḥ parikrīṇāmi
translation: [*7] (He buys it with the Mantras): 'If thou belongest to Soma, I buy thee for the king Soma. If thou belongest to Varuna, I buy thee for the king Varuna. If thou belongest to the Vasus, I buy thee for the Vasus. If thou belongest to the Rudras, I buy thee for the Rudras. If thou belongest to the Adityas, I buy thee for the Adityas. If thou belongest to the Maruts, I buy thee for the Maruts. If thou belongest to the Visve devas, I buy thee for the Visve devas.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: oṣadhayaḥ sumanaso bhūtvāsyāṃ vīryaṃ samādhatteyaṃ karma kariṣyatītyutthāpya tṛṇaiḥ paridhāyāhṛtya vaihāyasīṃ nidadhyāt
translation: He should set it up with (the Mantra), 'Ye herbs, being well-minded, bestow strength on this (shoot); for it will do its work.' Then he should put grass around it, should take it, and place it in the open air.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: dṛṣadaṃ prakṣālya brahmacārī vratavatī vā brahmabandhuḥ kumārī vāpratyāharantī pinaṣṭi
translation: Having washed a nether mill-stone, a student or a (wife) addicted (to her husband), a person who is a Brahmana by birth (only and not by learning), or a girl, pounds (that Nyagrodha shoot) without moving backward (the stone with which she pounds it).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prātaḥ saśiraskāplutodagagreṣu darbheṣu paścād agner udagagreṣu darbheṣu prākśirāḥ saṃviśati
translation: In the morning, after she has been washed, sitting on northward-pointed Darbha grass, (all over her body), including her head, she lies down to the west of the fire on northward-pointed Darbha grass, with her head to the east.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: paścāt patir avasthāya dakṣiṇasya pāṇer aṅguṣṭhenopakaniṣṭhikayā cāṅgulyābhisaṃgṛhya dakṣiṇe nāsikāsrotasyavanayet pumān agniḥ pumān indra ityetayarcā
translation: Her husband, standing behind her, should seize (the pounded Nyagrodha shoot) with the thumb and the fourth finger of his right hand, and should insert it into her right nostril with the verse, 'A man is Agni, a man is Indra' (MB. I, 4, 9).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Then they should do what they like.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: jananād yas tṛtīyo jyautsnas tasya tṛtīyāyāṃ prātaḥ saśiraskaṃ kumāram āplāvyāstamite vīte lohitimny añjalikṛtaḥ pitopatiṣṭhate
translation: [*1] On the third (Tithi) of the third bright fortnight after his birth, in the morning the father has the child washed, including his head, and after sunset, when the evening-red has disappeared, he worships (the moon), holding up his joined hands.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha mātā śucinā vasanena kumāram ācchādya dakṣiṇata udañcaṃ pitre prayacchaty udakśirasam
translation: Then the mother, having dressed the son in a clean garment, hands him, from south to north, with his face turned to the north, to the father.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: She then passes behind his back and stations herself to the north (of her husband).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha japati yat te susīma iti yathāyaṃ na pramīyeta putro janitryā adhīti
translation: He then murmurs (the three verses), 'Thy heart, O thou whose hair is well parted' (MB. I, 5, 10-12), and after he has, with the words (standing at the end of verse 12), 'That this son may not come to harm (and thus be torn) from his mother'--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Handed him, from south to north, to his mother, they may do what they like.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha ye 'ta ūrdhvaṃ jyautsnāḥ prathamoddiṣṭa eva teṣu pitopatiṣṭhate 'pām añjaliṃ pūrayitvābhimukhaś candramasam
translation: [*6] Then in the following bright fortnights (at the time) stated above (Sutra I), the father, filling his joined hands with water and turning his face towards the moon, worships it--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yad adaś candramasīti sakṛd yajuṣā dvis tūṣṇīm utsṛjya yathārtham
translation: Letting (the water) flow (out of his joined hands) once with the Yagus, 'What in the moon' (MB. I, 5, 13), and twice silently. Then they may do what they like.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha yas tat kariṣyan bhavati paścād agner udagagreṣu darbheṣu prāṅ upaviśati
translation: He who is going to perform (that ceremony--the father or a representative of the father), sits down to the west of the fire on northward-pointed Darbha grass, facing the east.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha mātā śucinā vasanena kumāram ācchādya dakṣiṇata udañcaṃ kartre prayacchaty udakśirasam
translation: [*10] Then the mother, having dressed the son in a clean garment, hands him, from south to north, with his face turned to the north, to the performer (of the ceremony).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: anupṛṣṭham parikramyottarata upaviśaty udagagreṣv eva darbheṣu
translation: She then passes behind his back and sits down to the north (of him), on northward-pointed Darbha grass.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha juhoti prajāpataye tithaye nakṣatrāya devatāyā iti
translation: [*12] He then sacrifices to Pragapati, to the Tithi (of the child's birth), to the Nakshatra (of the child's birth), and to the (presiding) deity (of that Tithi and of that Nakshatra).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tasya mukhyān prāṇān saṃmṛśan ko 'si katamo 'sīty etaṃ mantraṃ japati
translation: He then murmurs the Mantra, 'Who art thou? What person art thou?' (MB. I, 5, 14. 15), touching the sense-organs at (the boy's) head.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: āhaspatyaṃ māsaṃ praviśāsāv ity ante ca mantrasya ghoṣavadādy antarantasthaṃ dīrghābhiniṣṭhānāntaṃ kṛtaṃ nāma dadhyāt
translation: [*14] In (the passage of the Mantra), 'Enter upon the month, that belongs to Ahaspati (i.e. the lord of days), N.N.!' and at the end of the Mantra he should give him a name beginning with a sonant, with a semivowel in it, with a long vowel or the Visarga at the end, (and formed with) a Krit (suffix).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: It should not contain a Taddhita (suffix).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (He should give a name with) an odd (number of syllables), ending in -da, to girls.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A cow constitutes the sacrificial fee.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: kumārasya māsi māsi saṃvatsare sāṃvatsarikeṣu vā parvasvagnīndrau dyāvāpṛthivī viśvān devāṃś ca yajeta
translation: [*19] Every month (after the birth) of the boy, (or) after one year, or on the Parvan days of the year (i.e. on the last Tithi of each of the three seasons) he should sacrifice to Agni and Indra, to Heaven and Earth, and to the Visve devas.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: daivatam iṣṭvā tithiṃ nakṣatraṃ ca yajeta
translation: [*20] Having sacrificed to the deity (of the Tithi and of the Nakshatra respectively), he should sacrifice to the Tithi and to the Nakshatra.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: viproṣya jyeṣṭhasya putrasyobhābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ mūrdhānaṃ parigṛhya japed yadā vā pitā ma iti vidyād upetasya vāṅgād aṅgāt sambhavasīti
translation: [*21] When (the father) returns from a journey, or when (the son) begins to know, 'This is my father,' or when (the son) has been initiated, (the father) should grasp with his two hands his son round the head, and should murmur, 'From limb by limb thou art produced' (MB. I, 5, 16-18).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: With (the formula), 'With the cattle's himkara I kiss thee' (l.l. 19) he should kiss him. Then he may do what he likes.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the same way (he should do) to his younger sons--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: According to their age or in the order in which he meets them.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*25] Girls he should silently kiss on their head; he should silently kiss them on their head.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: uttarato gāṃ baddhvopatiṣṭherann arhaṇā putra uvāsa seti
translation: [*1] To the north of the place (in which the Arghya reception will be offered to a guest), they should bind a cow (to a post or the like), and should (reverentially) approach it with (the verse), 'Arhana putra vasa' (MB. II, 8, 1).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: idam aham imāṃ padyāṃ virājam annādyāyādhitiṣṭhāmīti pratitiṣṭhamāno japet
translation: [*2] (The guest to whom the Arghya reception is going to be offered) should come forward murmuring, 'Here I tread on this Padya Virag for the sake of the enjoyment of food' (ibid. 2).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (He should do so) where they are going to perform the Arghya ceremony for him,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or when they perform it.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Let them announce three times (to the guest) separately (each of the following things which are brought to him): a bed (of grass to sit down on), water for washing the feet, the Argha water, water for sipping, and the Madhuparka (i.e. a mixture of ghee, curds, and honey).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yā oṣadhīr ity udañcaṃ viṣṭaram āstīryādhyupaviśet
translation: Let him spread out the bed (of grass, so that the points of the grass are) turned to the north, with (the verse), 'The herbs which' (MB. II, 8, 3), and let him sit down thereon;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: If there are two (beds of grass), with the two (verses) separately (MB. II, 8, 3. 4);
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*8] On the second (he treads) with the feet.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Let him look at the water (with which he is to wash his feet), with (the formula), 'From which side I see the goddesses' (ibid. 5).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: savyaṃ pādam avanenija iti savyaṃ pādaṃ prakṣālayed dakṣiṇaṃ pādam avanenija iti dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ prakṣālayet
translation: Let him wash his left foot with (the formula), 'The left foot I wash;' let him wash his right foot with (the formula), 'The right foot I wash' (MB. II. 8, 6. 7);
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pūrvam anyam aparam anyam ity ubhau śeṣeṇa
translation: [*11] Both with the rest (of the Mantra, i.e. with the formula), 'First the one, then the other' (II, 8, 8).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Let him accept the Arghya water with (the formula), 'Thou art the queen of food' (ibid. 9).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The water (offered to him) for sipping he should sip with (the formula), 'Glory art thou' (ibid. 10).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yaśaso bhakṣo 'si mahaso bhakṣo 'si śrībhakṣo 'si śriyaṃ mayi dhehīti triḥ pibet
translation: [*15] Let him drink (of it) three times with (the formula which he repeats thrice), 'The glory's food art thou; the might's food art thou; the bliss's food art thou; bestow bliss on me' (MB. II, 8, 12);
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*16] Silently a fourth time.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Having drunk more of it, he should give the remainder to a Brahmana.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ācāntodakāya gaur iti nāpitas trir brūyāt
translation: After he has sipped water, the barber should thrice say to him, 'A cow!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: muñca gāṃ varuṇapāśād dviṣantaṃ me 'bhidhehīti taṃ jahy amuṣya cobhayor utsṛja gām attu tṛṇāni pibatūdakam iti brūyāt
translation: [*19] He should reply, 'Let loose the cow from the fetter of Varuna; bind (with it) him who hates me. Kill him and (the enemy) of N.N., (the enemies) of both (myself and N.N.). Deliver the cow; let it eat grass, let it drink water' (MB. II, 8, 13).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (And after the cow has been set at liberty), let him address it with (the verse), 'The mother of the Rudras' (MB. II, 8, 14).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*21] Thus if it is no sacrifice (at which the Arghya reception is offered),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (He should say), 'Make it (ready),' if it is a sacrifice.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: There are six persons to whom the Arghya reception is due, (namely),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ācārya ṛtvik snātako rājā vivāhyaḥ priyo 'tithir iti
translation: [*24] A teacher, an officiating priest, a Snataka, a king, the father-in-law, a friend coming as a guest.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*25] They should offer the Arghya reception (to such persons not more than) once a year.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: punar yajñavivāhayoś ca punar yajñavivāhayoś ca
translation: But repeatedly in the case of a sacrifice and of a wedding. But repeatedly in the case of a sacrifice and of a wedding.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*1] Let him daily repeat (the formula), 'Bhuh!' (MB. II, 4, 14) in order to avert involuntary death.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (He who does so) has nothing to fear from serious diseases or from sorcery.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The ceremony for) driving away misfortune (is as follows).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*4] It is performed on the sacrificial day (i.e. on the first day of the fortnight).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Oblations are made with the six verses), 'From the head' (MB. II, 5, 1 seq.), verse by verse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*6] The seventh (verse is), 'She who athwart' (MB. I, 5, 6).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*7] (Then follow) the verses of the Vamadevya,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (And) the Mahavyahritis.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The last (verse) is, 'Pragapati' (MB. II, 5, 8).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yaśo 'haṃ bhavāmīti yaśaskāma ādityam upatiṣṭheta pūrvāhṇamadhyandināparāhṇeṣu
translation: [*10] With the formula, 'I am glory' (MB. II, 5, 9) one who is desirous of glory should worship the sun in the forenoon, at noon, and in the afternoon,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Changing (the words), 'of the forenoon' (into 'of the noon,' and 'of the afternoon,' accordingly).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*13] One who desires to gain a hundred cart-loads (of gold), should keep the vow (of fasting) through one fortnight and should on the first day of a dark fortnight feed the Brahmanas with boiled milk-rice prepared of one Kamsa of rice.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tasya kaṇān aparāsu sandhivelāsu pratyaṅ grāmān niṣkramya catuṣpathe 'gnim upasamādhāyādityam abhimukho juhuyād bhalāya svāhā bhallāya svāheti
translation: [*14] At the evening twilight (of every day of that fortnight), having left the village in a westerly direction, and having put wood on the fire at a place where four roads meet, he should sacrifice the small grains (of that rice), turning his face towards the sun, with (the words), 'To Bhala Svaha! To Bhala Svaha!' (ibid. 17. 18).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (He should repeat those rites) in the same way the two next dark fortnights.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tāmisrāntareṣu brahmacārī syād ā samāpanād ā samāpanāt
translation: During the time between those dark fortnights he should observe chastity till the end (of the rite), till the end (of the rite).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*1] Let him select the site for building his house--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: On even ground, which is covered with grass, which cannot be destroyed (by inundations, &c.),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: On which the waters flow off to the east or to the north,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: On which plants grow which have no milky juice or thorns, and which are not acrid.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The earth should be white, if he is a Brahmana,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Red, if he is a Kshatriya,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Black, if he is a Vaisya.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sthirāghātam ekavarṇam aśuṣkam anūṣaram amaruparihitam akilinam
translation: (The soil should be) compact, one-coloured, not dry, not salinous, not surrounded by sandy desert, not swampy.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Soil) on which Darbha grass grows, (should be chosen) by one who is desirous of holy lustre,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Soil covered) with big sorts of grass, by one who is desirous of strength,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Soil covered) with tender grass, by one who is desirous of cattle.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The site of the house) should have the form of a brick,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or it should have the form of a round island.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yatra vā śvabhrāḥ svayaṃkhātāḥ sarvato 'bhimukhāḥ syuḥ
translation: Or there should be natural holes (in the ground) in all directions.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: On such (ground) one who is desirous of fame or strength, should build his house with its door to the east;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: One who is desirous of children or of cattle, (should build it) with its door to the north;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: One who is desirous of all (those things), (should build it) with its door to the south.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Let him not build it with its door to the west.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*19] And a back-door.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The house-door.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: So that (he?) may not be exposed to looks (?).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: varjayet pūrvato 'śvatthaṃ plakṣaṃ dakṣiṇatas tathā nyagrodham aparād deśād uttarāccāpy udumbaram
translation: [*22] 'Let him avoid an Asvattha tree on the east-side (of his house), and a Plaksha on the south-side, a Nyagrodha on the west-side, and on the north-side an Udumbara.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: aśvatthād agnibhayaṃ ca plakṣād brūyāt pramāyukān nyagrodhācchastrasaṃpīḍām akṣyāmayam udumbarāt
translation: 'One should say that an Asvattha brings (to the house) danger from fire; one should say that a Plaksha tree brings early death (to the inhabitants of the house), that a Nyagrodha brings oppression through (hostile) arms, that an Udumbara brings diseases of the eye.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ādityadevato 'śvatthaḥ plakṣaś ca yamadevataḥ nyagrodho vāruṇo vṛkṣaḥ prājāpatya udumbaraḥ
translation: 'The Asvattha is sacred to the sun, the Plaksha to Yama, the Nyagrodha is the tree that belongs to Varuna, the Udumbara, to Pragapati.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*25] He should place those (trees) in another place than their proper one,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*26] And should sacrifice to those same deities.

boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: āsanamāhāryāha sādhu bhavān āstām arcayiṣyāmo bhavantamiti
translation: Having ordered a seat to be got (for the guest), he says, 'Well, sir! sit down! We will do honour to you, sir!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*6]. Another person three times announces (to the guest) the couch and the other things (when they are offered to him).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He accepts the couch.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: varṣmo 'smi samānānām udyatāmiva sūryaḥ / imaṃ tamabhitiṣṭhāmi yo mā kaścābhidāsatīty enam abhyupaviśati
translation: [*8]. He sits down thereon with (the verse), 'I am the highest one among my people, as the sun among the thunder-bolts. Here I tread on whosoever infests me.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*9-10]. With the feet (he treads) on the other (bundle of grass).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When he is seated on the couch, he washes (for his guest) the left foot and then the right foot.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*11]. If (the host) is a Brahmana, the right first.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: virājo doho'si virājo dohamaśīya mayi pādyāyai virājo doha iti
translation: [*12]. (He does so) with (the formula), 'The milk of Virag art thou. The milk of Virag may I obtain. (May) the milk of Padya Virag (dwell) in me.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: arghaṃ pratigṛhṇāty āpaḥ stha yuṣmābhiḥ sarvān kāmān avāpnavānīti
translation: [*13]. He accepts the Arghya water with (the words), 'Waters are ye. May I obtain through you all my wishes.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ninayannabhimantrayate samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomi svāṃ yonim abhigacchata / ariṣṭā asmākaṃ vīrā mā parāseci mat paya iti
translation: Pouring it out he recites over (the waters the formula), 'To the ocean I send you; go back to your source. Unhurt be our men. May my sap not be shed.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ācāmaty ā māgan yaśasā saṃsṛja varcasā / taṃ mā kuru priyaṃ prajānāmadhipatiṃ paśūnām ariṣṭiṃ tanūnāmiti
translation: He sips water with (the formula), 'Thou camest to me with glory. Unite me with lustre. Make me beloved by all creatures, the lord of cattle, unhurtful for the bodies.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*17]. With (the formula), 'By the impulse of the god Savitri' (Vag. Samh. l.l.) he accepts it.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: savye pāṇau kṛtvā dakṣiṇasyānāmikayā triḥ prayauti namaḥ śyāvāsyāyānnaśane yat ta āviddhaṃ tatte niṣkṛntāmīti
translation: [*18]. Taking it into his left hand he stirs it about three times with the fourth finger of his right hand with (the formula), 'Adoration to the brown-faced One. What has been damaged in thee, when the food was eaten, that I cut off from thee.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And with the fourth finger and the thumb he spirts away (some part of the Madhuparka) three times.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tasya triḥ prāśnāti yanmadhuno madhavyaṃ paramaṃ rūpamannādyam / tenāhaṃ madhuno madhavyena parameṇa rūpeṇānnādyena paramo madhavyo 'nnādo 'sānīti
translation: He partakes of it three times with (the formula), 'What is the honied, highest form of honey, and the enjoyment of food, by that honied, highest form of honey, and by that enjoyment of food may I become highest, honied, and an enjoyer of food.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*21]. Or with (the verses) that contain the word 'honey,' verse by verse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*22]. Let him give the remainder (of the Madhuparka) to a son or a pupil who is sitting to the north.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*23]. Or let him eat the whole of it (himself).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*24]. Or he should pour out (the remainder) to the east, at an unfrequented spot.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ācamya prāṇānt saṃmṛśati vāṅma āsye nasoḥ prāṇo 'kṣṇoścakṣuḥ karṇayoḥ śrotraṃ bāhvor balam ūrvorojo 'riṣṭāni me 'ṅgāni tanūstanvā me saheti
translation: Having sipped water, he touches his bodily organs with (the formula), 'May speech dwell in my mouth, breath in my nose, sight in my eyes, hearing in my ears, strength in my arms, vigour in my thighs. May my limbs be unhurt, may my body be united with my body!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ācāntodakāya śāsam ādāya gauriti triḥ prāha
translation: When (the guest) has sipped water, (the host), holding a butcher's knife, says to him three times, 'A cow!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pratyāha / mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ / pra nu vocañ cikituṣe janāya mā gām anāgām aditiṃ vadhiṣṭa / mama cāmuṣya ca pāpmānaṃ hanomīti yadyālabheta
translation: He replies, 'The mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus, the sister of the Adityas, the navel of immortality. To the people who understand me, I say, "Do not kill the guiltless cow, which is Aditi." I kill my sin and N.N.'s sin,'--thus, if he chooses to have it killed.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha yady utsisṛkṣen mama cāmuṣya ca pāpmā hata omutsṛjata tṛṇānyattviti brūyāt
translation: But if he chooses to let it loose, he should say, 'My sin and N.N.'s sin has been killed. Om! Let it loose! Let it eat grass!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*29-30]. But let the Argha not be without flesh.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: On the occasion of a sacrifice and of a wedding let (the guest) say, 'Make it (ready).'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yady apy asakṛt saṃvatsarasya somena yajeta kṛtārghyā evainaṃ yājayeyur nākṛtārghyā iti śruteḥ
translation: [*31]. Even if he performs more than one Soma sacrifice during one year, let only priests who have received (from him) the Arghya reception, officiate for him, not such who have not received it; for this has been prescribed in the Sruti.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Having led her around the fire, keeping it on his right side, according to some (teachers)--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: paścād agnes tejanīṃ kaṭaṃ vā dakṣiṇapādena pravṛtyopaviśati
translation: Having pushed with his right foot a bundle of grass or a mat to the west of the fire, he sits down.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: anvārabdha āghārāv ājyabhāgau mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ prājāpatyaṃ sviṣṭakṛc ca
translation: [*3]. While (the bride) touches him, (the following oblations are made:) the two Aghara oblations, the two Agya portions, the Mahavyahritis, the general expiation, the Pragapatya oblation, and the Svishtakrit.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: These are regular (oblations) at every sacrifice.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prāṅ mahāvyāhṛtibhyaḥ sviṣṭakṛd anyac ced ājyāddhaviḥ
translation: The Svishtakrit comes before the Mahavyahritis, if the sacrificial food is different from Agya.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*6]. The place for the insertion (of the peculiar oblations belonging to the different sacrifices) is the interval between the general expiation and the oblation to Pragapati.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At the wedding (he may make oblations) with the Rashtrabhrit formulas (i.e. the formulas procuring royal power), if he likes, and with the Gaya and Abhyatana formulas (i.e. the formulas procuring victory, and aiming [at the hostile powers]), if he knows them--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*8]. Because it has been said, 'By what sacrifice he wishes to attain success.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agnir bhūtānām adhipatiḥ sa māvatv indro jyeṣṭhānāṃ yamaḥ pṛthivyā vāyur antarikṣasya sūryo divaś candramā nakṣatrāṇāṃ bṛhaspatir brahmaṇo mitraḥ satyānāṃ varuṇo 'pāṃ samudraḥ srotyānām annaṃ sāmrājyānām adhipatis tanmāvatu soma oṣadhīnāṃ savitā prasavānāṃ rudraḥ paśūnāṃ tvaṣṭā rūpāṇāṃ viṣṇuḥ parvatānāṃ maruto gaṇānām adhipatayas te māvantu pitaraḥ pitāmahāḥ pare 'vare tatāstatāmahāḥ / iha māvantv asmin brahmaṇy asmin kṣatre 'syām āśiṣyasyāṃ purodhāyām asmin karmaṇy asyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāheti sarvatrānuṣajati
translation: [*10]. (The Abhyatana formulas run thus): 'May Agni, the lord of beings, protect me. May Indra, (the lord) of the noblest, Yama, of the earth, Vayu, of the air, the Sun, of heaven, the Moon, of the Nakshatras, Brihaspati, of the Brahman, Mitra, of truth, Varuna, of the waters, the sea, of the rivers, food, the lord of royalty, protect me. May Soma, (the lord) of herbs, Savitri, of impulses, Rudra, of cattle, Tvashtri, of forms, Vishnu, of mountains, the Maruts, the lords of hosts, protect me. May the fathers, the grandfathers, the former, the later, the fathers, the grandfathers protect me here in this power of holiness, in this worldly power, in this prayer, in this Purohitaship, in this sacrifice, in this invocation of the gods. Svaha!'--this is added each time.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agnir aitu prathamo devatānāṃ so 'syai prajāṃ muñcatu mṛtyupāśāt / tad ayaṃ rājā varuṇo 'numanyatāṃ yatheyaṃ strī pautram aghaṃ na rodāt svāhā / imām agnis trāyatāṃ gārhapatyaḥ prajām asyai nayatu dīrgham āyuḥ / aśūnyopasthā jīvatām astu mātā pautram ānandam abhivibudhyatām iyaṃ svāhā / svasti no agne diva ā pṛthivyā viśvāni dhehyayathā yajatra yad asyāṃ mahi divi jātaṃ praśastaṃ tad asmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citraṃ svāhā / sugaṃ nu panthāṃ pradiśan na ehi jyotiṣmad dhehy ajaraṃ na āyuḥ / apaitu mṛtyur amṛtaṃ na āgād vaivasvato no abhayaṃ kṛṇotu svāheti
translation: (He then makes other oblations with the following texts:) 'May Agni come hither, the first of gods. May he release the offspring of this wife from the fetter of death. That may this king Varuna grant, that this wife may not weep over distress (falling to her lot) through her sons. Svaha! 'May Agni Garhapatya protect this woman. May he lead her offspring to old age. With fertile womb may she be the mother of living children. May she experience delight in her sons. Svaha! 'Make, Agni, all ways of heaven and earth blissful to us, O thou who art worthy of sacrifices. What is great, born on this (earth); and praised, (born) in heaven, that bestow on us, rich treasures. Svaha! 'Come hither, showing us an easy path. Give us bright, undecaying life. May death go away; may immortality come to us. May Vivasvat's son make us safe from danger. Svaha!
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And the (verse), 'Another way, O death' (Vag. Samh. XXXV, 7), after the eating (of the remnant of the sacrificial food), according to some (teachers).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*1]. On an auspicious day the harnessing to the plough. Or under (the Nakshatra) Gyeshtha, (because that rite is) sacred to Indra.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: indraṃ parjanyamaśvinau maruta udalākāśyapaṃ svātikārīṃ sītām anumatiṃ ca dadhnā taṇḍulair gandhair akṣatair iṣṭvānaḍuho madhughṛte prāśayet
translation: [*2]. To Indra, Parganya, the two Asvins, the Maruts, Udalakasyapa, Svatikari, Sita, and Anumati, he offers curds, rice grains, perfumes, and fried grains, and then makes the bullocks eat honey and ghee.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He should put them to the plough with (the verse), 'They harness to the ploughs' (Vag. Samh. XII, 67).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: śunaṃ su phālā iti kṛṣet phālaṃ vālabheta
translation: With (the verse), 'For luck may us the ploughshares' (Vag. Samh. XII, 69) let him plough or touch the plough-share.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*5]. Or (he may) not (do so), because (that verse) has been prescribed for (the erection of) the Agni (-altar), and the act of sowing stands in connection (with it).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: After the front-bullock has been sprinkled (with water), they then should plough unploughed ground.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Then (follows) feeding of the Brahmanas.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pāyasamaindraṃ śrapayitvāpūpāṃś cāpūpaiḥ stīrtvājyabhāgāv iṣṭvājyāhutīr juhotīndrāyendrāṇyā ajāyaikapade 'hirbudhnyāya prauṣṭhapadābhyaśceti
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
