translation: [*1]. Having walked round the fire with his right side turned towards it, he sits down.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: anvārabdha ājyāhutīrhutvā prāśanānte 'thainaṃ saṃśāsti brahmacāry asy apo 'śāna karma kuru mā divā suṣupthā vācaṃ yaccha samidham ādhehy apo 'śāneti
translation: Taking hold (of the student), he sacrifices the Agya oblations, and after having partaken (of the remains of the sacrificial food) he instructs him, 'A student art thou. Take water. Do the service. Do not sleep in the day-time. Keep silence. Put fuel on (the fire). Take water.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: athāsmai sāvitrīm anvāhottarato 'gneḥ pratyaṅmukhāyopaviṣṭāyopasannāya samīkṣamāṇāya samīkṣitāya
translation: He then recites the Savitri to him, who is seated to the north of the fire, with his face to the west, sitting near the teacher, and looks (at the teacher), while (the teacher) looks at him;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*4]. Some say, to (the student) who is standing or seated to the south (of the fire);
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Pada by Pada, (then) hemistich by hemistich, and the third time the whole (verse), reciting it together (with the student);
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sadyastveva gāyatrīṃ brāhmaṇāyānubrūyād āgneyo vai brāhmaṇa iti śruteḥ
translation: [*7]. To a Brahmana, however, he should recite a (Savitri) verse in the Gayatri metre immediately. For it is said in the Sruti, 'To Agni indeed belongs the Brahmana.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A Trishtubh verse to a Raganya,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A Gagati to a Vaisya,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or a Gayatri to (persons of) all (castes).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Now the putting on of fuel.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pradakṣiṇam agniṃ paryukṣyottiṣṭhant samidham ādadhāti agnaye samidham ahārṣaṃ bṛhate jātavedase / yathā tvamagne samidhā samidhyasa evam ahamāyuṣā medhayā varcasā prajayā paśubhirbrahmavarcasena samindhe jīvaputro mamācāryo medhāvyaham asāny anirākāriṣṇur yaśasvī tejasvī brahmavarcasyannādo bhūyāsaṃ svāheti
translation: [*3]. Having sprinkled (water) round the fire from left to right, he stands up and puts a piece of wood on (the fire) with (the texts), 'To Agni I have brought a piece of wood, to the great Gatavedas. As thou, Agni, art inflamed by wood, thus I am inflamed by life, insight, vigour, offspring, cattle, holy lustre. 'May my teacher be the father of living sons; may I be full of insight, not forgetful (of what I have learned); may I become full of glory, of splendour, of holy lustre, an enjoyer of food. Svaha!
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the same way (he puts on) a second (piece of wood); and thus a third.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: eṣā ta iti vā samuccayo vā
translation: Or (each piece) with (the verse), 'Thine is this' (Vag. Samh. II, 14).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or (he uses) both (this verse and the formulas given in Sutra 3).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pāṇī pratapya mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe tanūpā agne 'si tanvaṃ me pāhy āyurdā agne 'syāyur me dehi varcodā agne'si varco me dehi / agne yanme tanvā ūnaṃ tanma āpṛṇa
translation: [*7]. The wiping and sprinkling (of water) round (the fire are repeated) as above.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: medhāṃ me devaḥ savitā ādadhātu medhāṃ me devī sarasvatī ādadhātu medhām aśvinau devāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajāviti
translation: Having warmed his two hands, he wipes his mouth with (the formulas): 'Agni, thou art the protector of bodies. Protect my body. Agni, thou art the giver of life. Give me life. Agni, thou art the giver of vigour. Give me vigour. 'Agni, what is deficient in my body, that restore to fulness. 'May the god Savitri bestow insight on me, may the goddess Sarasvati, may the two divine Asvins, wreathed with lotus, (bestow) insight (on me).'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Here (follows the student's) going the rounds for alms.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*2-4]. A Brahmana should beg, addressing (the woman from whom he begs alms) with the word 'Lady' put at the beginning (of his request),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A Raganya, with the word 'Lady' inserted in the middle,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A Vaisya, with the word 'Lady' put at the end.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*5]. (He should beg) from three women who will not refuse;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: From six, twelve, or an indefinite number.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: From his own mother first, according to some (teachers).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*8]. Having announced the alms received to his teacher, he should stand, keeping silence, through the rest of the day, according to some.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ahiṃsann araṇyāt samidha āhṛtya tasminn agnau pūrvavad ādhāya vācaṃ visṛjate
translation: [*9]. Having fetched fire-wood out of the forest without damaging (trees), he should put them on that fire as above, and should abandon his silence.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He should sleep on the ground and eat no pungent or saline food.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Wearing the staff, worshipping the fire, being obedient to his Guru, going the rounds for alms--(these are the standing duties of students).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*12]. He should avoid honey or flesh, bathing (for pleasure), sitting on high seats, going to women, falsehood, and taking what is not given to him.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*13-15]. Let him live forty-eight years as a student for the (four) Vedas,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or twelve years for each Veda,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or until he has learnt it.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The garment (of a student) should be made of hemp, flax, or wool (accordingly as he is a Brahmana, a Kshatriya, or a Vaisya).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The upper garment of a Brahmana should be an antelope-skin,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: That of a Raganya the skin of a spotted deer,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: That of a Vaisya a goat's or cow's skin.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or if (the prescribed sort of garment) is not to be had, a cow's hide (should be worn) by all, because to that belongs the first place (among all kinds of garments).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The girdle of a Brahmana should be of Munga grass,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: That of a Kshatriya should be a bowstring,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: That of a Vaisya, made of Murva (i.e. Sanseveria Roxburghiana).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*24]. If there is no Munga (or the other articles prescribed in  section section 22, 23, the girdles should be made) of Kusa grass, of the plant Asmantaka, or of Balbaga grass (respectively).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The staff of a Brahmana is of Palasa wood,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: That of a Raganya of Bilva wood,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: audumbaro vaiśyasya keśasaṃmito brāhmaṇasya lalāṭasaṃmitaḥ kṣatriyasya ghrāṇasaṃmito vaiśyasya sarve vā sarveṣām
translation: That of a Vaisya of Udumbara wood.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or all (sorts of staffs may be used) by all.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: śayānaṃ cedāsīna āsīnaṃ cettiṣṭhaṃstiṣṭhantaṃ cedabhikrāmann abhikrāmantaṃ cedabhidhāvan
translation: If the teacher calls him, he shall rise and then answer..
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sa evaṃ vartamāno 'mutrādya vasatyamutrādya vasatīti tasya snātakasya kīrtirbhavati
translation: If (the teacher calls him) while he is lying down, (he should answer) sitting; if sitting, standing; if standing, walking up (to the teacher); if walking up, running up.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: trayaḥ snātakā bhavanti vidyāsnātako vratasnātako vidyāvratasnātaka iti
translation: If he behaves thus, his fame when he has become a Snataka (i.e. when he has taken the bath at the end of his studentship) will be (such that people will say of him), 'To-day he stays there; to-day he stays there.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: samāpya vedam asamāpya vrataṃ yaḥ samāvartate sa vidyāsnātakaḥ
translation: [*32-35]. There are three (kinds of) Snatakas: a Vidya-snataka (i.e. a Snataka by knowledge), a Vrata-snataka (i.e. a Snataka by the completion of his vows), and a Vidya-vrata-snataka (i.e. a Snataka both by knowledge and by the completion of his vows).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: samāpya vratam asamāpya vedaṃ yaḥ samāvartate sa vratasnātakaḥ
translation: He who performs the Samavartana ceremony, after having finished the study of the Veda, but before the time of his vows has expired, is a Vidya-snataka.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ubhayaṃ samāpya yaḥ samāvartate sa vidyāvratasnātaka iti
translation: He who performs the Samavartana, after his vows have expired, but before he has finished the study of the Veda, is a Vrata-snataka.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He who performs the Samavartana, after having finished both, is a Vidya-vrata-snataka.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*36-40]. Until the sixteenth year the time (for being initiated) has not passed for a Brahmana,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Until the twenty-second for a Raganya,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Until the twenty-fourth for a Vaisya.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: nainān upanayeyur nādhyāpayeyur na yājayeyur na caibhir vyavahareyuḥ
translation: After that (time has passed), they become patitasavitrika (or persons who have lost the right of learning the Savitri).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: No one should initiate such men, nor teach them, nor perform sacrifices for them, nor have intercourse with them.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tripuruṣaṃ patitasāvitrīkāṇām apatye saṃskāro nādhyāpanaṃ ca
translation: [*41]. After the time has passed, (they should do) as has been prescribed.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When he has finished the Veda, he should take the bath (by which he becomes a Snataka);
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*3]. Or also after (a studentship) of twelve years, according to some (teachers).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Let him take the bath only) if his Guru has given his permission.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*5]. Rules (regarding the performance of sacrifices), (texts) to be used (at the sacrifices according to those rules), and reasoning (on the meaning of the rites and texts): that is the Veda.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*6]. Some say (that the Veda should be studied) with its six Angas;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Not so that he only knows the ceremonial.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: But optionally by one who knows the sacrifices (the bath may be taken).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: upasaṃgṛhya guruṃ samidho 'bhyādhāya pariśritasyottarataḥ kuśeṣu prāgagreṣu purastātsthitvāṣṭānām udakumbhānām
translation: (The student) after having embraced (the feet of) his teacher, and put the pieces of wood on the fire, places himself northwards of an enclosure, on eastward-pointed Kusa grass, to the east of eight vessels with water.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ye apsvantaragnayaḥ praviṣṭā gohya upagohyo mayūṣo manohā skhalo virujas tanūdūṣur indriyahātān vijahāmi yo rocanastamiha gṛhṇāmītyekasmād apo gṛhītvā
translation: [*10]. 'The fires that dwell in the waters; the fire which must be hidden, the fire which must be covered, the ray of light, the fire which kills the mind, the unwavering one, the pain-causing one, the destroyer of the body, the fire which kills the organs--those I leave behind. The shining one, that I seize here'--with (this formula) he draws water out of one (of the eight vessels);
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tenābhiṣiñcate / tena māmabhiṣiñcāmi śriyai yaśase brahmaṇe brahmavarcasāyeti
translation: With that he besprinkles himself with (the words), 'Therewith I besprinkle myself for the sake of prosperity, of glory, of holiness, of holy lustre.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yena śriyamakṛṇutāṃ yenāvamṛśatāṃ surām / yenākṣyāvabhyaṣiñcatāṃ yadvāṃ tad aśvinā yaśa iti
translation: [*12]. (A second time he draws water out of a second of the eight vessels with the formula given in Sutra 10, putting instead of the words, 'The shining one, &c.,' the verse): 'By which you have created prosperity, by which you have touched sura, with which you have anointed the eyes, which is your' glory, O Asvins.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (And he draws water out of three other vessels) with (the three verses), 'Ye waters are' (Vag. Samh. XI, 50-52), verse by verse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: With (water drawn out of) the three other (vessels he besprinkles himself) silently.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ud uttamam iti mekhalāmunmucya daṇḍaṃ nidhāya vāso 'nyat paridhāyādityamupatiṣṭhate
translation: Having loosened his girdle with (the verse), 'The highest band' (Vag. Samh. XII, 12), having put it down, having put on another garment, he worships the sun--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: udyan bhrājabhṛṣṇur indro marudbhir asthāt prātaryāvabhir asthād daśasanir asi daśasaniṃ mā kurv āvidaṃ mā gamaya / udyan bhrājabhṛṣṇur indro marudbhirasthād divāyāvabhir asthācchatasanirasi śatasaniṃ mā kurv āvidaṃ mā gamaya / udyan bhrājabhṛṣṇur indro marudbhir asthāt sāyaṃyāvabhir asthāt sahasrasanirasi sahasrasaniṃ mā kurv āvidaṃ mā gamayeti
translation: [*16]. With (the formulas), 'Rising, bearing a shining spear, Indra stands with the Maruts; he stands with the gods who walk in the morning. Thou art a tenfold winner; make me a tenfold winner. Make me attain to renown. Rising, bearing a shining spear, Indra stands with the Maruts; he stands with the gods who walk in day-time. Thou art a hundredfold winner; make me a hundredfold winner. Make me attain to renown. Rising, bearing a shining spear, Indra stands with the Maruts; he stands with the gods who walk in the evening. Thou art a thousandfold winner; make me a thousandfold winner. Make me attain to renown.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: dadhitilānvā prāśya jaṭālomanakhāni saṃhṛtyaudumbareṇa dantān dhāveta / annādyāya vyūhadhvaṃ somo rājāyam āgamat / sa me mukhaṃ pramārkṣyate yaśasā ca bhagena ceti
translation: Having eaten curds or sesamum seeds, and having had his matted hair, the hair of his body, and his nails cut, he should cleanse his teeth with an Udumbara branch with (the verse), 'Array yourselves for the enjoyment of food. Here has come king Soma: he will purify my mouth with glory and fortune.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: utsādya punaḥ snātvānulepanaṃ nāsikayormukhasya copagṛhṇīte prāṇāpānau me tarpaya cakṣurme tarpaya śrotraṃ me tarpayeti
translation: Having anointed himself and bathed again, he takes up the salve for nose and mouth with (the words), 'Satiate my up-breathing and down-breathing; satiate my eye; satiate my ear!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pitaraḥ śundhadhvamiti pāṇyor avanejanaṃ dakṣiṇā niṣicyānulipya japet / sucakṣā ahamakṣībhyāṃ bhūyāsaṃ suvarcā mukhena / suśrut karṇābhyāṃ bhūyāsamiti
translation: Having poured out to the south the water with which he has washed his hands, with (the words), 'Ye fathers, become pure,' he should salve himself and murmur, 'May I become well-looking with my eyes, well-shining with my face, well-hearing with my ears.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ahataṃ vāso dhautaṃ vāmautreṇāchādayīta / paridhāsyai yaśodhāsyai dīrghāyutvāya jaradaṣṭirasmi / śataṃ ca jīvāmi śaradaḥ purūcī rāyaspoṣam abhisaṃvyayiṣya iti
translation: [*20]. He then should put on a garment which has not yet been washed, or not been soaked in lie, with (the formula), 'For the sake of putting on, of bringing fame, of long life I shall reach old age. I live a hundred long autumns. For the sake of the increase of wealth I will clothe myself.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: athottarīyam / yaśasā mā dyāvāpṛthivī yaśasendrābṛhaspatī / yaśo bhagaśca māvindad yaśo mā pratipadyatāmiti
translation: Then the upper garment with (the verse), 'With glory (come) to me, Heaven and Earth. With glory, Indra and Brihaspati! May glory and fortune come to me! may glory be my lot!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*22]. If (he has only) one (garment), he should cover himself (with a part of that garment as if it were an upper garment) with the second part of the former (Mantra; Sutra 20).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sumanasaḥ pratigṛhṇāti / yā āharajjamadagniḥ śraddhāyai medhāyai kāmāyendriyāya / tā ahaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi yaśasā ca bhagena ceti
translation: [*23]. He takes flowers with (the formula), '(The flowers) which Gamadagni has brought for the sake of faith (has brought to Sraddha?), of love, of the senses, them I take with glory and with fortune.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: athāvabadhnīte yad yaśo 'psarasām indraścakāra vipulaṃ pṛthu / tena saṃgrathitāḥ sumanasa ābadhnāmi yaśo mayīti
translation: He then ties them (to his head) with (the verse), 'The high, wide glory, which Indra has created for the Apsarases, the flowers bound up with that, I tie on to me, to bring me glory!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: uṣṇīṣeṇa śiro veṣṭayate yuvā suvāsā iti
translation: [*25]. He binds a turban to his head with (the verse), 'A youth, well attired.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (He puts on) the two ear-rings with (the words), 'An ornament art thou; may more ornaments be mine.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He salves his two eyes with (the formula), 'Vritra's' (Vag. Samh. IV, 3 b).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: With (the words), 'Brilliant art thou,' he looks at his image in a mirror.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: chatraṃ pratigṛhṇāti / bṛhaspateśchadirasi pāpmano mām antardhehi tejaso yaśaso māntardhehīti
translation: He takes a parasol with (the words), 'Thou art Brihaspati's covering. Shelter me from evil. Do not shelter me from splendour and glory.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pratiṣṭhe stho viśvato mā pātam ity upānahau pratimuñcate
translation: With (the words), 'You are supports; protect me from all sides,' he puts on the two shoes.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: viśvābhyo mā nāṣṭrābhyas paripāhi sarvata iti vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍamādatte
translation: With (the words), 'From all powers of destruction protect me on all sides,' he takes a bamboo staff.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (For) the tooth-cleaner, &c. (the Mantras stated above are to be used) in every case; (for) the garment, the parasol, and the shoes, the Mantra (should only be recited) if they have not been used before.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*1]. Now (follow) the five great sacrifices.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*3]. To the domestic deities (he offers) three
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To Dhatri and Vidhatri at the two doorposts;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To the different quarters (of the horizon), to Vayu and (to the presiding deities) of the quarters;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the middle three (Balis) to Brahman, to the Air, to the Sun.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: viśvebhyo devebhyo viśvebhyaśca bhūtebhyas teṣām uttarataḥ
translation: To the north of those (he offers Balis) to the Visve devas and to all the beings;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Further on to Ushas and to the Lord of beings;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To the south (to the Fathers) with (the words), To the Fathers, Svadha! Adoration!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pātraṃ nirṇijyottarāparasyāṃ diśi ninayed yakṣmaitat ta iti
translation: Having rinsed out the vessel, he should pour it out towards the north-west with (the words), 'Consumption! this to thee!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*11]. Taking the Brahmana's portion (of the food which he is going to distribute), he should give it to a Brahmana, after he has made him wash himself, with (the words), 'Well! (this) to thee!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To (religious) mendicants and to guests they should apportion (food) as due to them.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The persons belonging to the house, the young and the old, should eat what is due to them;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Afterwards the householder and his wife.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pūrvo vā gṛhapatiḥ / tasmād u svāṣṭaṃ gṛhapatiḥ pūrvo 'tithibhyo 'śnīyād iti śruteḥ
translation: [*15]. Or the householder (should eat) first, because the Sruti says, 'Therefore the householder should eat the sweetest food before his guests.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: aharahaḥ svāhākuryād annābhāve kenacid ā kāṣṭhād devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo manuṣyebhyaścodapātrāt
translation: [*16]. Every day he should sacrifice with the word svaha. If he has no food (to offer, he should make his offering) with something else, be it even a piece of wood (only), to the gods, or be it (only) a water-pot, to the Fathers and to men.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha prāśnāti / agniḥ prathamaḥ prāśnātu sa hi veda yathā haviḥ / śivā asmabhyam oṣadhīḥ kṛṇotu viśvacarṣaṇiḥ / bhadrānnaḥ śreyaḥ samanaiṣṭa devās tvayāvasena samaśīmahi tvā / sa no mayobhūḥ pito āviśasva śaṃ tokāya tanuve syona iti
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha yavānām etamutyaṃ madhunā saṃyutam / yavaṃ sarasvatyā adhi vanāya cakṛṣuḥ indra āsīt sīrapatiḥ śatakratuḥ kīnāśā āsanmarutaḥ sudānava iti
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: abhisamāvartsyamāno yatrāntyāṃ samidham abhyādadhyāt tam agnim indhīta
translation: [*2]. When (a pupil) is going to return (from his teacher), let him keep that fire (as his domestic fire) on which he has put the last piece of wood (as required by the regulations for a student),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or (he should keep) his nuptial fire.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Some declare (that the domestic fire should be kindled) at the time of the division of the inheritance.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*5]. Or that after the death of the householder the eldest one himself (should kindle it).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (It should be kindled) on the day of the new moon of the month of Vaisakha or on another (new moon day).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Some say (that the fire should be kindled) according to the (sacrificer's) wishes under the (corresponding) constellation.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*8]. He should light his fire at one of the following places, viz. in the house of a Vaisya who is rich in cattle, at a frying-pan, or (at the fire of) one who offers many sacrifices.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*9-11]. Some say that (the fire should be fetched from one of the above-mentioned places) in the evening and in the morning.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The inauguration (of the fire) by an evening offering should be learnt from the Adhvaryus, according to (my) teacher.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prātaḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyād vaiṣṇavyarcā tūṣṇīṃ vā
translation: In the morning he shall offer a full oblation with a verse sacred to Vishnu, or silently.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*12]. The time for setting it (i.e. the domestic fire) in a blaze and for sacrificing on it has been explained by (the rules given with regard to) the Agnihotra.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*13]. And 'invested with the sacrificial cord,' etc., all these rules, as far as they are applicable, should be applied (here also) in consequence of the unity of the ritual.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: With regard to this they quote also (the following Sloka):
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pākasaṃsthā haviḥsaṃsthāḥ somasaṃsthās tathāparāḥ / ekaviṃśatir ity etā yajñasaṃsthāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
translation: [*15]. 'The kinds of Pakayagnas, the kinds of Haviryagnas, and again the kinds of Soma sacrifices, 'Twenty-one by number, these are proclaimed to be the kinds of sacrifice.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*1]. Forms the standard for all sacrifices that procure happiness,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And for all Agya offerings,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*3]. For the sacrifice of animals which are tied to a branch,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*4]. And for the offerings of boiled (rice) grains and of cooked food.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: There are also the following Slokas:
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: huto 'gnihotrahomenāhuto balikarmaṇā / prahutaḥ pitṛkarmaṇā prāśito brāhmaṇe hutaḥ
translation: [*7]. '(An oblation is called) HUTA, (if made) by the performing of the Agnihotra; AHUTA (i.e. unsacrificed, if) by the Bali offering; PRAHUTA (i.e. sacrificed up, if) by a sacrifice to the Manes; PRASITA (i.e. tasted, if) deposited as an offering in a Brahmana.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: anūrdhvajñur vyūḍhajānur juhuyāt sarvadā haviḥ / na hi bāhyahutaṃ devāḥ pratigṛhṇanti karhicit
translation: [*8]. 'Without raising his knees, with spread knees let him always offer his oblation; for the gods never accept an offering (that has been made holding the hand) not between (the knees).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: raudraṃ tu rākṣasaṃ pitryam āsuraṃ cābhicārikam / uktvā mantraṃ spṛśed apa ālabhyātmānam eva ca
translation: [*9]. 'But when he has repeated a text sacred to Rudra, to the Rakshas, to the Manes, to the Asuras, or that contains an imprecation, let him touch water, and so also when he has touched his own body.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: iyaṃ nāry upabrūte lājān āvapantikā śivā jñātibhyo bhūyāsaṃ ciraṃ jīvatu me patiḥ svāheti tiṣṭhantī juhoti patir mantraṃ japati
translation: 'This woman, strewing grains, prays thus, "May I bring bliss to my relations; may my husband live long. Svaha!"'--while the husband murmurs (this) text, she sacrifices standing.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*2]. (All the ceremonies,) beginning from the treading upon the stone, (are repeated) in the same way for a second time,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And in the same way a third time.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Silently, if they like, a fourth time.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*5]. (The Akarya?) makes (them) step forward in a north-eastern direction seven steps (with the words),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: iṣa ekapady ūrje dvipadī rāyaspoṣāya tripady āyobhavyāya catuṣpadī paśubhyaḥ pañcapady ṛtubhyaḥ ṣaṭpadī sakhā saptapadī bhaveti
translation: 'For sap with one step, for juice with two steps, for the prospering of wealth with three steps, for comfort with four steps, for cattle with five steps, for the seasons with six steps. Friend be with seven steps.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The Akarya?) 'appeases' those (foot-steps) with water.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*8]. With the three Apohishthiya verses (Rig-veda X, 9, 1-3) he wipes (them) with the Stheya water,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*9]. And sprinkles it on their heads.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The bridegroom then) says, 'I give you a cow.'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*12]. To him who knows the Surya hymn the bride's shift.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*13-15]. A cow is the optional gift to be given by a Brahmana,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A village by a Raganya,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A horse by a Vaisya.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*16]. A hundred (cows) with a chariot (he gives to a father) who has only daughters.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To those versed in the sacrificial rites he gives a horse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pra tvā muñcāmīti tṛcaṃ gṛhāt pratiṣṭhamānāyāṃ
translation: The three verses, 'I loosen thee' (Rig-veda X, 85, 24), when she departs from the house.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: 'The living one they bewail' (Rig-veda X, 40, 10), if she begins to cry.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha rathākṣasyopāñjanaṃ patnī kurute 'kṣann amīmadantety etayā sarpiṣā
translation: [*3]. The wife then smears the axle of the chariot with clarified butter with this (verse), 'They feasted, they got drunk' (Rig-veda I, 82, 2),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And with the two (verses), 'Pure are thy wheels,' 'Thy two wheels' (Rig-veda X, 85, 12. 16), of the two wheels the first with the first (verse) and the second with the second (verse),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And the two bulls.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: phalavato vṛkṣasya śamyāgarteṣv ekaikāṃ vayāṃ nikhāya
translation: [*6]. After (the wife?) has put, with this (verse), 'In the box of the wheel' (Rig-veda VIII, 80, 7), a branch of a fruit-bearing tree into each of the holes destined for the pins,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or, if (such branches) are (already) fixed, has recited (that verse) over them,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: athosrau yuñjanti yuktas te astu dakṣiṇa iti dvābhyāṃ śukrāv anaḍvāhāv ity etenārdharcena yuktāv abhimantrya
translation: They then harness the two bulls with the two (verses), 'Harnessed be thy right one' (Rig-veda I, 82, 5-6), (the bridegroom) reciting the half-verse, 'White the two bulls' (Rig-veda X, 85, 10), over them when they have been harnessed.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha yadi rathāṅgaṃ viśīryeta chidyeta vāhitāgner gṛhān kanyāṃ prapādya
translation: Now should any part of the chariot break or burst, let him take the girl to the house of one who keeps the sacred fires,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And repair (the damage) with the verse, 'Cover thyself with the Khadiras' (Rig-veda III, 53, 19).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A knot with the verse, 'Him like a horse' (Rig-veda X, 143, 2).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: svasti no mimītām iti pañcarcaṃ japati
translation: He then murmurs the five verses, 'May prosperity give us' (Rig-veda V, 51, 11-15).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: 'Adorned with Kimsuka flowers' (Rig-veda X, 85, 20), when she mounts the chariot;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: 'May no waylayers meet us' (ibid. 32), at a cross-way;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vanaspate śatavalśa iti vanaspatāv ardharcaṃ japati
translation: The half-verse, 'O tree with thy hundred branches' (Rig-veda III, 8, 11), he mutters near a big tree;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: 'The good protectress' (Rig-Veda X, 63, 10), when she ascends a ship;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: 'Carrying stones' (Rig-veda X, 53, 8), when she crosses a river;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Optionally (he) also (murmurs the same verse, if that is done) with the harnessed chariot;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: 'Up may your wave' (Rig-veda III, 33, 13), at deep places (in the river);
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And (at such places) let her not look out.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: iha priyam iti sapta gṛhān prāptāyāḥ kṛtāḥ parihāpya
translation: The seven verses, 'Here may delight' (Rig-veda X, 85, 27 seq.), when she has reached the house, omitting the verses already employed.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the fourth month the Garbharakshana (i.e. the ceremony for the protection of the embryo),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: akṣībhyāṃ te nāsikābhyām iti pratyṛcam ājyalepenāṅgāny anuvimṛjya
translation: With (the verses), 'From thy eyes, thy nose' (Rig-veda X, 163), verse by verse besmearing her limbs with Agya salve.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*2-6]. Goat's flesh, if he is desirous of nourishment,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*3]. Flesh of partridge, if desirous of holy lustre,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Fish, if desirous of swiftness,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Boiled rice with ghee, if desirous of splendour--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Such) food, prepared with milk curds, honey, and ghee, he should give (to the child) to eat.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: annapate 'nnasya no dehy anamīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ pra pradātāraṃ tāriṣa ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade yacciddhi mahaś cid imam agna āyuṣe varcase tigmam ojo varuṇa soma rājan mātevāsmā aditiḥ śarma yaṃsad viśve devā jaradaṣṭir yathāsad iti hutvā
translation: [*7]. After he has made oblations with (the verses), 'Lord of food, give us food, painless and strong; bring forward the giver; bestow power on us, on men and animals;' 'Whatsoever' (Rig-veda IV, 12, 4); 'Even of great' (ibid. 5), 'Him, Agni, (lead) to long life and splendour; sharp strength (mayst thou), Varuna, king Soma, protection may Aditi, like a mother, afford to him, and all the gods that he may reach old age'--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And has recited over (the child) the verse, 'Powers of life, Agni' (Rig-veda IX, 66, 19),
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: udagagreṣu kuśeṣu syonā pṛthivi bhavety upaveśya
translation: And has set him down on northward pointed Kusa grass with (the verse), 'Be soft, O earth' (Rig-veda I, 22, 15)--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The act of feeding is performed with the Mahavyahritis.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Let the mother eat the remnant.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*1]. The Sruva spoon (serves as) a vessel.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: According to the purpose the properties (of the different things to be used at each oblation) should be chosen.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: savyena kuśān ādāya dakṣiṇena mūle sruvaṃ viṣṇor hasto 'sīti
translation: [*3]. Taking up Kusa blades with the left, and the Sruva at its bottom with the right hand, with the words, 'The hand of Vishnu art thou'--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*4]. He offers with the Sruva the Agya oblations.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: uttarapaścārdhād agner ārabhyāvicchinnaṃ dakṣiṇato juhoti tvam agne pramatir iti
translation: [*5]. Beginning from the north-west side of the fire he offers (the Agya) unintermittingly on the south side (of the fire) with (the verse), 'Thou Agni art full of foresight' (Rig-veda I, 31, 10).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: dakṣiṇapaścārdhād agner ārabhyāvicchinnam uttarato juhoti yasyeme himavanta iti
translation: Beginning from the south-west side of the fire he unintermittingly offers on the north side with (the verse), 'To whom these snowy mountains' (Rig-veda X, 121, 4).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To Agni belongs the northern Agya portion, to Soma the southern.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*8]. In the middle (are made) the other oblations,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agnir janitā sa me 'mūṃ jāyāṃ dadātu svāhā somo janimān sa māmuyā janimantaṃ karotu svāhā pūṣā jñātimān sa māmuṣyai pitrā mātrā bhrātṛbhir jñātimantaṃ karotu svāheti
translation: (With the words,) 'Agni is the begetter; may he give to me N.N. as my wife; svaha! 'Soma is rich in wives; may he make me rich in wives by N.N.; svaha! 'Pushan is rich in kindred; may he make me rich in kindred by the father, the mother, the brothers of N.N.; svaha!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*10]. At the Agya oblations the offering of the two Agya portions and of the Svishtakrit oblation is not standing,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*11]. Nor in the standing oblations, according to Mandukeya.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*12]. The place for the insertion is the interval between the Mahavyahritis, the general expiation, and the oblation to Pragapati.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ājye haviṣi savye pāṇau ye kuśās tān dakṣiṇenāgre saṃgṛhya mūle savyena teṣām agraṃ sruve samanakti madhyam ājyasthālyāṃ mūlaṃ ca
translation: If the oblation consists in Agya, let him seize the Kusa blades in his left hand with his right hand at their points and with the left at their roots, and let him wet their points (with Agya) in the Sruva, the middle and the roots in the Agya pot;
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When he then has thrown them (into the fire) with the words, 'Agni's garment art thou,'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And has put on (the fire) three pieces of wood,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*17]. (Water) is sprinkled round (the fire) as stated above.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: anāmnātamantrāsv ādiṣṭadevatāsv amuṣyai svāhāmuṣyai svāheti juhuyāt svāhākāreṇa śuddhena
translation: Oblations for which only the deities are indicated, but no texts prescribed, are to be made merely with the word SVAHA, 'To such and such a deity svaha! To such and such a deity svaha!'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*19]. The ritual (here) declared of the sacrifice (to be performed) when (the father's) assent (to give away his daughter) has been declared--
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: madhuparke ca some ca pitṛdaivatakarmaṇi / atraiva paśavo hiṃsyā nānyatrety abravīn manuḥ
translation: 'At the Madhuparka and at the Soma sacrifice, at the sacred rites for fathers (Manes) and gods only animals may be killed, not elsewhere: thus has Manu said.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ācāryaś ca pitā cobhau sakhā cānatithir gṛhe / te yad vidadhyus tat kuryād iti dharmo vidhīyate
translation: 'Both his teacher and his father, and also a friend who does not stay in his house as a guest: whatever these dispose, that let him do; such is the established custom.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: naikagrāmīṇam atithiṃ viproṣyāgatam eva ca / upasthitaṃ gṛhe vidyād bhāryā yatrāgnayo 'pi vā
translation: [*3]. 'Let him not consider as a guest a person living in the same village, or one that comes in returning from a journey; (but let him consider as a guest only) one who has arrived at his house where the wife or the fires (of the host) are.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: devatāḥ puruṣaṃ gṛhyā aharahar gṛhamedhinam / bhāgārtham upasarpanti tābhyo nirvaptum arhati
translation: 'Day by day the domestic deities approach the man who performs the domestic rites, in order to receive their share; (that) let him pour out to them.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: iyaṃ duruktāt paribādhamānā varṇaṃ pavitraṃ punatī na āgāt prāṇāpānābhyāṃ balam āviśantī sakhā devī subhagā mekhaleyam iti trir mekhalāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ triḥ pariveṣṭya
translation: 'Here has come to us, protecting (us) from evil words, purifying our kin as a purifier, clothing herself, by (the power of) inhalation and exhalation, with strength, this friendly goddess, this blessed girdle'--with these words, three times repeated, he ties the girdle from left to right thrice round.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: granthir ekas trayo 'pi vāpi vā pañca
translation: [*2]. (There should be) one knot, or also three, or also five.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*4]. He fills the two hollows of (his own and the student's) joined hands (with water), and then says to him: 'What is thy name?'
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: 'I am N.N., sir,' says the other.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: [*6-7]. 'Descending from the same Rishis?' says the teacher.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: 'Descending from the same Rishis, sir,' says the other.
