translation: The introductory (triplet for the vaiśvadeva-śastra) is the same as that of the second day.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The antistrophe-triplet is: "The golden-handed".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pra samrājaḥ ka īṃ vyaktā huve vaḥ sudyotmānam ity āgnimārute
translation: The (differences) at the āgnimāruta-śastra (are that the hymn to Vaiśvānara here is): "Forwards the praise to the all ruling" (the hymn to the Maruts: "Who are the men revealed"; (the hymn to Jātavedas): "I call the effulgent".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: abhijit sarvastoma ubhayasāmā rathantarapṛṣṭho bṛhatpṛṣṭho vāgniṣṭomaḥ
translation: The abhijit is an agniṣṭoma which contains all the stomas, both the sāmans, and has either the rathantara or the bṛhat as (first) pṛṣṭha-(stotra).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pra vo devāya yad vāhiṣṭham ity ājyam
translation: The ājya-śastra consists of (the hymn): "Forwards to the God" and (the triplet): "What is carrying best".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The praiga-śastra is that of Madhucchandas and that of Gṛtsamada.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: First come the triplets of that of Madhucchandas, afterwards that of Gṛtsamada.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or the (whole) morning-service should be that of the one-day-sacrifice of Soma.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: indra piba tubhyaṃ suto madāyety aikāhikād ūrdhvaṃ marutvatīyāt
translation: (At the midday-service), he (inserts after the hymn of the) marutvatīya-śastra of the one-day-rite (the hymn): "O Indra, drink, for thy delight the Soma is pressed".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: After the (hymn of the) niṣkevalya-śastra (of the one-day-rite) (he inserts the hymn): "Which help is yours".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: But in case (the abhijit) has the bṛhat as first pṛṣṭha-stotra these two hymns come first,
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ekasūkte vā / pibā somam abhi tam u ṣṭuhīti / pūrvasyottamām utsṛjati
translation: Or the two (the marutvatīya- and niṣkevalya-śastra) consist of one (hymn only), (viz. the marutvatīya of the hymn beginning): "Drink the Soma towards which" (and the niṣkevalya of the hymn beginning): "Him do thou praise" of the first hymn he omits the last verse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The third service follows the one-day-rite.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The svarasāman days are seventeen-versed.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ prathamasya bṛhad dvitīyasyobhayasāmā tṛtīyo rathantarapṛṣṭhaḥ
translation: The rathantara is the (first) pṛṣṭha-stotra of the first, and the bṛhat of the second, the third has both the sāmans but the rathantara as first pṛṣṭha-stotra.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: According to Kauṣitaki they have the (sāmans called) 'svara' as (first) pṛṣṭha(-stotra on each day).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In this case the rathantara and the bṛhat (are chanted) at the pavamāna-lauds.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: According to Kauṣitaki they are ukthyas.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ā yajñair bṛhad vayo 'gna ojiṣṭham ity ājyāni sarvatrottamāḥ parihāpya
translation: The (hymns for the) ājya (śastras) are (for the first day): "O God with sacrifices the moṛtal"; (for the second day): "Great strength"; (for the third): "O Agni, bring hither the most mighty"; everywhere with omission of the last verse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The praüga-śastras are those of the first three day set (of the prsthya six-day-period).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: kva sya vīra iti prathamasya svarasāṃno marutvatīyaṃ kayāśubhīyaṃ dvitīyasya gāyat sāmeti tṛtīyasya
translation: The (hymn of the) marutvatīya-(śastra) is for the first svarasāman day: "Where is that hero"; for the second the 'with-what array' hymn; for the third: "Let him sing the saman".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: kaṃ navya iti prathame kad ū nv asyeti dvitīya imā u tvā purūvaso iti tṛtīye bṛhataś ca yoniḥ
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yas te sādhiṣṭha ity uttamāṃ parihāpyārvāgratham iti ca prathame gāyanti tvāpād ita ud u naiś citratama iti dvitīya indraṃ viśvāḥ saṃ ca tve jagmur iti tṛtīye
translation: (The hymns for the niṣkevalya-śastra are): at the first (svarasāman day): "What is thy most effectual" and without the last verse, (and) "May the bay steeds convey thy chariot hither"; at the second (day): "The singers sing thee", and "He hath drunk hence"; at the third (day): "Indra all have caused to grow", and "In thee have come together the songs".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In this manner if the svarasāman days have the rathantara and the bṛhat (as first pṛṣṭha-stotras).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (But) if the svarasāmans are used (for the first pṛṣṭha-stotras) the triplet: "When thou wast born, O unequalled one" is the stotra-triplet (for all the three days).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yad indra citra mehaneti dve yā indra bhuja iti tṛtīyānurūpasya
translation: For the anurūpa triplet (are used) the two (verses): "What, O wonderful Indra, abundantly", and as third: "Which profits thou hast brought, O Indra" (so for the first svarasāman day).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: matsy apāyi te maha iti vā dvitīyasya / prathamāṃ tṛtīyāṃ karoti
translation: Or (the stotra-triplet) for the second (svarasāman day) is (the triṣṭich): "Be glad, thou hast drunk the Soma", of which he takes the first as third verse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: matsi no vasyaīṣṭaya iti dve vayaṃ gha tveti tṛtīyānurūpasya
translation: For the anurūpa (triplet at the second svarasāman day) (are used) the two (verses: "Be glad for our welfare"; and as third: "We are in thee, O Indra".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: praty asmai pipīṣata iti vā tṛtīyasya / caturthīṃ tṛtīyāṃ karoti
translation: Or (the stotra-triplet) for the third (svarasāman day is the triṣṭich): "Bring unto him, the thirsty one", of which he takes the fourth as third.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: imam indra sutaṃ pibeti dve ka īṃ vedeti tṛtīyānurūpasya
translation: For the anurūpa (triplet at the third svarasāman day) (are used) the two verses: "Drink, O Indra, this Soma"; and as third: "Who knows him together with the Soma".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Whenever the stotra-triplet has the bṛhati (verses) at that (corresponding place the bṛhatīs must be applied in the anurūpa triplet.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: dhāyyāṃ śastvā kadvataś ca rathantarasya yoniṃ prathame bṛhato dvitīya ubhayos tṛtīye
translation: Having recited the inteṚcalatory verse and the (pragāthas) containing the word 'who', he recites at the first day the yoni of the rathantaras, at the second day that of the bṛhat, at the third day those of both.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Everywhere (when both are mentioned) at the first place that of the rathantara (and at the second place that of the bṛhat).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yam indra dadhiṣa iti dve prathame svaranti tveti dvitīye dānā mṛgo na vāraṇa iti tṛtīye
translation: (Immediately after that yoni-verse he recites) at the first (svarasāman day) the two verses: "Which horse thou dost support, O Indra"; at the second day the two (verses: "The men call thee at the Soma"; and at the third the two (verses): "As a wild elephant".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: indra tubhyam in maghavann iti navānāṃ tisras tisro 'nvahaṃ pūrvāṇi ca sūktāni
translation: Then he recites of the nine verses: "O bountiful Indra, to thee" on each (svarasāman) day three verses and the first hymns.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or he leaves aside the triplets and recites both hymns.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The same should be done) in case they (the rathantara and the bṛhat) are adapted to the yonis of the svara (saman).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prāg ānuṣṭubhāt tṛcād vā pragāthena saṃśaṃsati
translation: In reciting he connects the pragātha before the anuṣṭubh part or before the triplet.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: That the third services (of the svarasāman days) follow the rite of the first three days (of the prsthya six-day-period) prevails for these days, in case they have the rathantara and bṛhat (as first pṛṣṭha-stotra).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And the beginning triplets (pratipads) of these same days (prevail) also for the svarasāman days if they have the svara saman (as first pṛṣṭha-stctras).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And for the yonis of the svara (saman)s.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: From the anucara triplets on, they follow (the rite of) the middle three-day-period in the connected form (samudha).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or at the first (day) by the hymn: "Agni, Indra".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And (in this case) the hymn to the Maruts is: "Those who shine forth".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The hymn: "I call the Gods" at the second day.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The hymn: "Dawn and night" at the third.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The viṣuvat day is an agniṣṭoma, of which each laud consists of twentyone verses, and which has either the bṛhat or the mahādivākīrtyas as (first) pṛṣṭha-(laud).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: It must be brought to an end before sun-set.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The morning-litany (takes place immediately) when the sun has risen.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or as in the normal rite.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agniṃ manye pitaram ity udite pratipat prātar anuvākasya
translation: The beginning verse of the morning-litany (when it is begun) after sunrise is: "Agni I deem father".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He should recite (at the morning-litany) a hundred or a hundred and ten or a hundred and twenty (verses).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The āprī hymn is the one seen by Vasiṣṭha.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: A (he-goat) destined for Sūrya must be immolated in addition to the usual one of the pressing day.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: citraṃ devānām iti puronuvākyās tisra uttarā yājyā sauryasya
translation: For the victim to Sūrya the invīting-verses are the three beginning: "The bright face of the Gods has risen" and the three following ones are the offering-verses.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The rite of this victimal sacrifice is performed) whisperingly.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The (hymn for the) ājya-(śastra) is: "Out of the ocean the wave".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The praüga-śastra is in triṣṭubh metre (composed as follows).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: madhyamāc chandomāt trīṇi tṛcāni prathame cottamaṃ ca
translation: From the middle chandoma day (are taken) three triplets: the first two and the last.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Three are taken from the first chandoma day.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: But the third verse is the one containing the word 'blaze'.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or the morning service (may be) that of the one-day-rite.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pra vo devāya tvaṃ hi kṣaitavad iti vā tad ājyam
translation: Its ājya(-śastra consists of the two hymns): "Forward to the God"; and "For thou princely glory".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And the praüga-śastra is that of Madhucchandas.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: kayā śubhā tyaṃ su meṣaṃ janiṣṭhā ugra iti marutvatīyam
translation: The hymns for the marutvatīya-(śastra) are: "With what array"; and "That ram"; "Thou, the terrible, hast been born".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: śrāyanta iva sūryam iti stotriyo 'sva yonau bṛhati
translation: The stotra-triplet is: "Leaning, as it were, on Sūrya" in case the bṛhat is not chanted on its own yoni.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The corresponding triplet is: "It thou hadst a hundred skys".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or (the stotra-triplet is that of the mahādivākīrtya.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The stotra-triplet of the mahādivākīrtya is: "The bright face of the Gods".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: baṇ mahān ud u tyad darśatam iti vā stotriyānurūpau pragāthau
translation: Or the pragāthas to serve as stotra- and corresponding-triplets are: "Assuredly thou art great, O Sun" and "Upwards that beautiful".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vibhrāḍ bṛhad iti vā stotriyo vi sūryo madhya ity anurūpaḥ
translation: Or the stotra-triplet is: "May the radiant drink the great" and the corresponding triplet is: "The sun has loosened in the middle".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or (the corresponding triplet is): "May we always, well-disposed, see thee".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The sama-pragātha is: "Assuredly thou art great, O sun".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or: "Who ever slayeth, most active".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Then he recites) the yoni of the rathantara, in case the bṛhat is performed on its own yoni.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Of both (he recites the yonis of both: rathantara and bṛhat), if it (the bṛhat) is performed on another verse than its yoni.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Likewise at the mahādivākīrtya, if the chanters apply them (rathantara and bṛhat) at the pavamāna-laud.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Of the second day (the hymn) for the marutvatīya(-śastra is): "These oblations call thee".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: suta it tvaṃ nimiśla iti niṣkevalyam
translation: The (hymn) for the niṣkevalya-śastra is: "Thou art devoted to the pressed Soma".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The hymn to Savitṛ (of the vaiśvadeva-śastra) is that of the one-day-sacrifice.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The hymn to the Ṛbhus (of the same śastra) is: "Stretched is the work".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The same is applied at the fifth day.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The hymn to Jātavedas of the āgnimāruta-śastra is the same as that of the caturviṃśa day.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The rest is simiḍār to the second day (of the prsthya six-day-period).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Of the third day the praüga śastra is that of Viśvamanas in uṣṇih verses (as follows):
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vāyo yāhi śivā vāṃ sahasraṃ tā vāṃ viśvasyā vāṃ vāhiṣṭhaḥ sakhāya ā śiṣāmahy uta no devy aditir uta naḥ priyeti praugatṛcāni /2/
translation: The triplets for the praüga are: (to Vāyu): "Come hither, O kind Vāyu"; (to Indra-Vāyu): "May the thousand convey both of you hither"; (to Mitra and Varuṇa): "Ye both the chiefs of all"; (to the Aśvins): "May your conveying chariot come"; (to Indra): "O friends, we would supplicate"; (to the All-Gods: "May the Goddess Aditi for us"; (to Sarasvatī): "And Sarasvatī has become dear to us".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The (hymn for the marutvatīya-śastra is): "Mount the two bay steeds".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The (hymn for the) niṣkevalya agrees with that of the one-day soma rite.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The (hymn to the Heaven and Earth of the vaiśvadeva-śastra is the) triplet: "In melted butter are Heaven and Earth envelopped".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The same triplet at the sixth day.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ā rudrāsas tvām agna ṛtāyava ity āgnimārutam
translation: The (hymn to the Maruts at the) āgnimāruta-(śastra) is: "Come hither, ye Rudras" (and the hymn to Jātavedas at the same śastra): "Thee, O Agni, the righteous".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sakhāyaḥ saṃ vaḥ saṃyañcam ity ājyaṃ pṛṣṭhasya sarvatrottamāṃ parihāpya
translation: Of the sixth (day the hymn for) the ājya-(śastra) is: "O friends, together the seemly", everywhere the last verse of this hymn is omitted.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The praüga-(śastra) is one 'to be collected'.

text_iast: agna ā yāhi vītaye yo agniṃ devavītaye
translation: (For the iṣṭi to Agni Vīti, III.4.3): "Agni come to the feast (vīti)"; "He who Agni to the feast of the Gods".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: kayā no 'gne vivasas tvām agne mānuṣīḥ
translation: (For the iṣṭi to Agni the separator, III.4.4): "How hast thou, O Agni, our praise"; "Thee, O Agni, the tribes of men praise".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: kuvit su no mā no 'smin mahādhane
translation: (For the iṣṭi to Agni the despoiler, III.4.5): "In our cattle fray"; "Do not as in the great contest".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (For the iṣṭi to Agni who resides in the waters, III.4.7): "In the waters, O Agni, in thy seat"; "The great one has increased in the wide".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (For the iṣṭi to Rudra, III.1.8): "What shall we say to Rudra"; "May we attain thy good-will".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (For the iṣṭi to Pūṣan the path maker, III.4.9): "We have, O Pūṣan, pathmaker"; "Of path on path".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agniḥ pareṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya / samrāḍ eko vi rājati // aśyāma tam
translation: (For the iṣṭi to Agni Kāma, III.4.10): "Agni, as Kāma, in distant domains rules, the one universal ruler, over what has been and is to be"; "May we win our wish, O Agni".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi patsutas tve vasūni purvaṇīka hotaḥ
translation: (For the iṣṭi to Agni Kṣāmavat, III.4.13): "The black spaces at the feet"; "In thee, O many-faced hotṛ".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: marutas tveṣasadṛśa ā yāta yamāv iva / śubhrā hiraṇyakhādayaḥ // vātatviṣo marutaḥ śriye kam iti vā
translation: (For the isți to the Maruts, III.4.14): "Ye Maruts of glittering aspect, come hither as two twins; radiant, wearing golden brooches"; (and as offering-verse either): "The Maruts impetuous as wind" or "For welfare".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agniḥ prathamo vasubhir no avyāt somo rudrair abhi rakṣatu tmanā / indro marudbhir ṛtuthā kṛṇotv ādityair no varuṇaḥ śarma yaṃsat // sam agnir vasubhir no 'vyāt saṃ somo rudriyābhis tanūbhiḥ / sam indro rātahavyo marudbhiḥ sam ādityair varuṇo viśvavedāḥ
translation: The invīting- and offering-verses are: "May Agni, together with the Vasus aid us in the first place, let Soma together with the Rudras protect us also; let Indra together with the Maruts act in due course; let Varuṇa together with the Ādityas confer protection on us". "May Agni together with the Vasus aid us; and Soma with his Rudraic forms; and Indra, the liberal worshipper, together with the Maruts and Varuṇa the all-knowing together with the Ādityas".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And they should mutter the hymn of concordance.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yaṃ vāṃ devā akalpayann ūrjo bhāgaṃ śatakratū / idaṃ vāṃ tena prīṇāmi tasya tṛmpatam ahāhāhuhū svāhā / gandharvābhyāṃ nārīṣ ṭābhyām ahāhāhuhūbhyāṃ svāhā / agne pṛthivyā adhipate vāyo 'ntarikṣasyādhipate savitaḥ prasavānām adhipate sūrya nakṣatrāṇām adhipate somauṣadhīnām adhipate tvaṣṭaḥ samidhāṃ rūpāṇām adhipate mitra satyānām adhipate varuṇa dharmāṇām adhipate indra jyeṣṭhānām adhipate prajāpate prajānām adhipate devā deveṣu parākramadhvam
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prathamā dvitīyeṣu parākramadhvam ity evam ekottaram aikādaśabhyaḥ
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When the śamīṣṭayajus oblation is performed he lays hold from behind (on the adhvaryu).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sadasi san me bhūyāḥ sarvam asi sarvaṃ me bhūyāḥ pūrṇam asi pūrṇaṃ me bhūyā akṣitir asi mā me kṣeṣṭhā amutrā amuṣmiṃl loka iha ceti pūrṇapātram abhimṛśya diśo vyudukṣati
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Once each time with the mantras, (thereupon) twice each time silently.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: āpohiṣṭhīyābhis tisṛbhir abhimṛśya / acchāyaṃ vo yayor ojaseti prācīr ninīyodīcīr vā / samudraṃ vaḥ pra hiṇomi svāṃ yonim abhi gacchata / ariṣṭā asmākaṃ vīrā mā parā seci no dhanam // ity abhimantrya / śaṃnodevīyābhiś catasṛbhir uro 'bhimṛśya / sam indra naḥ saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhir aganmahi manasā saṃ śivena / tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāya iti prāṇān / anu no mārṣṭu tanvo yad viliṣṭam // iti mukhaṃ vimṛjya / viṣṇukramān kramate
translation: Having touched (the remains of the water) with the three verses beginning: "Ye waters are wonderful" and having poured (it) out eastwards or northwards with the (two verses): "May this praise fetch you" and "By whose vigour the spheres were propped up" he addresses it with (the verse): "I send you off to the ocean, go ye to your own place of origin. Our men (may be) unhurt. May our possession not be spilled". He then touches his breast with the four verses: "Hail to us the Goddesses", and (the openings of) his vital breaths with (the two): "With thought lead us to meet, O Indra", and "We have united with lustre, with sap, with bodies, and with happy thought. May Tvaṣṭṛ, the dispenser of boons, grant us riches", and with (the last verse-quarter of the lastly cited verse): "And may he make even what was injured in our body", he wipes his mouth.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: mainam agna iti saṃpradīpte daśa japitvā savyāvṛto 'navekṣamāṇāḥ prāgudañcaḥ prakrāmanti
translation: After he has muttered, when (the corpse) is set to flames, the ten (verses beginning): "Do not burn him, O Agni", they strive forth making a turn with the skins, to the north, without looking on (without looking backwards).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: With the two (verses): "Effacing the foot-trace of Death" he bespeaks them.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: āpo hi ṣṭhā sanā ca somety udakaṃ spṛśanti sūktābhyām anaman nimajjanto 'saṃdhāvamānāḥ
translation: They (betake themselves to a stream and) touch the water (= bathe) with the two hymns: "Ye waters, are wonderful" and "Gain thou, O Soma, and conquer", plunging into (the water) without bending (their head beneath the surface) and not rubbing themselves (their hands for cleansing).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: asāv etat ta ity ekam udakāñjaliṃ pradāya / āpo asmān ity utkramya / ahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāya / tac cakṣur ity ādityam upasthāya / kaniṣṭhapūrvāḥ pratyāyanti
translation: Having presented (to the deceased with the formula): "So and so this for thee" a gift of water poured out of the two open hands held together, they step out of the water repeating (the verse) "May the waters, the brothers, purify us", put on a new garment, revere the Sun with (the verse): "May we behold that eye ordained by the Gods" and return to their home, the youngest ones preceding.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: udapātre dūrvā yavasarṣapāṇy opyārdre gomaye nidhāyāśmanvatīty abhyaktam aśmānam agnim udapātraṃ ca saṃmṛśanti
translation: Thereupon in a vessel filled with water having thrown dūrvā grass, barley and mustard-seed, he deposits this vessel on fresh cow-dung and touches with (the verse): "Here floweth the stony-one" a stone which has been anointed, the fire and a vessel filled with water.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: nāghāhāni vardhayeyur iti ha smāha kauṣītakiḥ
translation: "They should not increase the days of evil" thus Kauṣitaki used to say.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: aparapakṣe saṃcityāyujāsu rātriṣu / yaṃ tvam agna iti dvābhyāṃ sakṣīreṇodakenāsthīni nirvāpya / purāṇe kumbhe śarīrāṇy opya
translation: On the uneven days of the second half of the month (under waning-moon) he allays with the two (verses): "Whom thou, O Agni, hast burnt" the bones with a mixture of water and milk, throws the bones into an old pitcher, covers (this pitcher) with (the verse): "I prop for thee the earth" with a lump of earth, buries it with (the verse): "Gape, O Earth" into a ditch, and puts it with (the verse): "Let the gaping earth stand firm" on a spot surrounded by wooden posts. They bury it in the wood.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: If the bones are not found, (they take) three hundred and sixty stalks of palāśa.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: These are distributed (in the following manner):

translation: In this manner there are three hundred and sixty stalks.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvorṇāṣūtraiḥ pariveṣṭya yavacūrṇaiḥ pralipya sarpiṣābhyajyāgnibhiḥ saṃkurvanti
translation: He makes them into the semblance of a man, surrounds them (fixes them together) with the woolen threads, smears them with powdered barley, anoints them with liquified butter, whereupon they consecrate (= cremate) him by his fires.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: icchan patnīṃ pūrvamāriṇīm agnibhiḥ saṃskṛtya sāṃtapanena vānyām ānīya tataḥ punar ādadhīta
translation: If he wishes he may consecrate his wife, if she has died before him, with his fires or with fires which he gets indirectly from his sacred fires, then he should take another wife and establish his sacred fires anew.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yā tiraścī ni padyate ahaṃ vidharaṇī iti / tāṃ ghṛtasya dhārayā yuje samardhamīm aham // svāhā
translation: "She who lies athwart, thinking: 'it is I who keep (all things) asunder', to her who brings prosperity, I offer this stream of butter, svaḥa".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yasyedaṃ sarvaṃ tam imaṃ havāmahe / sa me kāmān kāmapatiḥ pra yacchatu // svāheti dvitīyām
translation: "Him we call unto us, whose is all what is here. He, the lord of wishes, may grant me (the fulfilment of) my wishes, svaḥa" for the second libation.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: "O Agni, ruler over the Earth" (is for) the third.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: "O Prajāpati, no other than thou" (is for) the fourth.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: trīṇi palāśa palāśāni madhyamāni saṃtṛḍyopastīrya / vapām avadhāyābhighārya / yāvatām aham īśe yāvanto me amātyāḥ / tebhyas tvā deva vande tebhyo no deva mṛḍa / veda te pitaraṃ veda mātaraṃ dyaus te pitā pṛthivī mātā / tasmai te deva bhavāya śarvāya paśupataya ugrāya devāya mahate devāya rudrāyeśānāyāśanaye svāheti vapāṃ hutvā / anupraharati palāśāni
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: darśāya te pratidarśāya svāhety uttarām ājyāhutiṃ hutvā tathaiva paryukṣati
translation: Having performed a subsequent libation of liquified butter with (the formula): "To thy appearing, to (thy) counter-appearing svaḥa" he sprinkles water all around (the fire) in the same manner.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To the north of the fire he cooks the portions (of the victim which must be offered).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ṣaḍarghyā bhavanty ācārya ṛtvik śvaśuro rājā snātakaḥ priya iti
translation: Six (kinds of) persons are worthy of a respectful reception as a guest: the spiritual teacher, the officiating-priest, the father-in-law, the king, the Veda-student who has taken his absolving bath, the friend.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā ahaṃ varṣma sādṛśānāṃ vidyutām iva sūryaḥ / idaṃ tam adhi tiṣṭhāmi yo asmāṁ abhi dāsati // iti kūrcam adhyāste 'dhi tiṣṭhati vā
translation: Turning his face to the north or to the east, he either sits down or steps on the bundle of grass with (the verse): "I am the highest of my people, as the sun is the highest of the lightning flashes. Here I tread on him, who infects us".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: virājo doho 'si virājo doham aśīya mayi padyāyai virājo doha iti pādyaṃ pratigṛhya
translation: The water for washing the feet he accepts with (the formula): "Thou art the milk of the virāj. May I obtain the milk of the virāj. In me (may dwell) the milk of the verse-quarter virāj".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: It is when he is addressed by the host with the word: "The aṛghya-water (I present to thee)", he accepts the water.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ācamanīyam ity ukta āpo hi ṣṭhīyābhis tisṛbhir ekaikayācamya
translation: When he is addressed: "The (water) for sipping", he sips with the three verses: "Ye waters are wonderful" with each verse once.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He accepts it in the same manner, the only difference is (that he adds at the end of the formula) the words: "For fame, for brahman-lustre".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pratigṛhya savye pāṇau kṛtvāṅguṣṭhenopakaniṣṭhikayā ca pūrvārdhād upahatya pūrvārdhe kāṃsyasya nilimpati vasavas tvāgnirājāno bhakṣayantv iti
translation: Having accepted it he puts it in his left hand, takes with the thumb and ring-finger (a small quantity) out of it at the fore-part of the brass vessel and smears this on its fore-part with the formula: "May the Vasus, whose king is Agni, paṛtake of thee".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pitaras tvā yamarājāno bhakṣayantv iti dakṣiṇārdhād dakṣiṇārdhe
translation: With (the formula): "May the Fathers, whose king is Yama, paṛtake of thee" (he takes a small quantity) from the southern part (and smears it) on the southern part (of the vessel).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ādityās tvā varuṇarājāno bhakṣayantv iti parśārdhāt paścārdhena
translation: With (the formula): "May the Ādityas, whose king is Varuṇa, paṛtake of thee", (he takes a small quantity) from the western part (and smears it) on the western part.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: rudrās tvā indrarājāno bhakṣayantv ity uttarārdhād uttarārdhe
translation: With (the formula): "May the Rudras, whose king is Indra, paṛtake of thee" (he takes) from the northern part (and smears it) on the northern part.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: viśve tvā devāḥ prajāpatirājāno bhakṣayantv iti mādhyād ūrdhvam
translation: With (the formula): "May the All-Gods, whose king is Prajāpati, paṛtake of thee" (he takes) from the middle (and throws it) upwards.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Each time once with the mantras, twice without a mantra.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: mātā rudrāṇām iti japitvotsṛjata tṛṇāny attv iti vā
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: kūrcaḥ pādyam arghyam ācamanīyaṃ madhuparko gaur iti vedayeta vedayeta
translation: He should announce to the guest successively: "The bundle", "The foot-water", "The aṛghya-water", "The water for sipping", "The honey-mixture", "The cow".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Acts (which fall to the share) of the brahman are performed at the southern part (of the vihāra).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: To the west, however, at the sacrifice to the Fathers.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The change of place has to conform to that of the sacrificer.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: His seat is before (to the east of) the sacrificer.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The rite of throwing away the grass blade (before he sets himself down) is simiḍār to that of the hotṛ.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Likewise that of sitting down.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: It (i.e. this manner of sitting down prevails) at the beginning of a (set of religious) act(s) and in case of separation of locality.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The modification (in regard to the rite of the hotṛ is) that the tip (of the grass-stalk) is directed to the east.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He is the eye-witness of all the acts.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At acts which are accompanied by a mantra he restrains his voice.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sarvāsu gatiṣu yathā vrajanty anyathā tataḥ pratyāyanti
translation: Wherever they move about, they return by a different path from that which they had taken when beginning to go.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When the fire is being carried forward, he accompanies at the south side (the adhvaryu and others).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At the moment when the fuel-stick is put on (the newly established Āhāvaniya) he sits down.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The horse (is destined) for the brahman at the establishment of the fires.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or for all (the priests).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: karmaprasavāyāmantrita om ity uktvā yathākarma prasauti

text_iast: paśudevatām āvāhya vanaspatiṃ ca / indraṃ vasumantam āvahendraṃ rudravantam āvahendram ādityavantam ṛbhumantaṃ vibhumantaṃ vājavantaṃ bṛhaspatimantaṃ viśvadevyāvantam āvaheti savanadevatāḥ
translation: Having summoned the deity for which the victim is destined, to come near and having summoned Vanaspati, he summons the deities of the (three) services (with the words): “Summon Indra who is joined by the Vasus, summon Indra who is joined by the Rudras, summon Indra who is joined by the Ādityas, by the Ṛbhus, the Vibhus, the Vājas, by Bṛhaspati, by the All-Gods”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: They (these deities of the savanas) do not enter (i.e. are not inserted) at the other places in the prose recitation (where in the prakṛti the deity is to be inserted).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the sūktavāka they may be inserted.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Having touched the two adhvaryus, they offer the two libations for the choosing according to the order of their libation.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: juṣṭo vāco bhūyāsaṃ juṣṭo vācaspater devi vāg yat te vāco madhumattamaṃ tasmin no adya dhāt svāhā sarasvatyā iti pūrvām
translation: The first with (the formula): "May I be agreeable to Vāc, agreeable to Vācaspati. Divine word, place us in what of thy word today is sweetest. Hail to Sarasvatī”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The second silently.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: hotar vadasvety ukta uttiṣṭhatāva paśyateti prathamām abhiṣṭauti
translation: When he has been addressed (by the adhvaryu) with the words: "Hotr speak what thou hast to speak", he recites over (the dadhigharma) the first (verse): "Arise ye, look down on”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: śrātaṃ havir ity ukte dvitīyāṃ sūktasya
translation: When it has been said (by the pratiprasthātṛ): "Cooked is the sacrificial substance”, he recites over it the second verse of the hymn.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: When he has been addressed (by the pratiprasthātṛ) with the words: "Recite the offering-verse for the dadhigharma” he recites as offering-verse the third verse of the hymn.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He recites each verse over (the dadhigharma) without taking breath (at the end of a half-verse) and with the prāṇava (o3) (making a pause at the end of the prāṇava).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the same manner he speaks the offering-verse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The secondary vaṣaṭ is: "Of the dadhigharma, O Agni, enjoy”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: mayi tyad indriyaṃ bṛhan mayi dakṣo mayi kratuḥ / gharmas triśug virocata ākūtyā manasā saha / virājā jyotiṣā saha tasya doham aśīmahi / iti bhakṣamantraḥ
translation: The mantra for paṛtaking is: "(May there be) in me that great foṚce, in me the fitness, in me the intelligence. The gharma of triple fires shineth, together with the wish: the mind, together with the virāj: the light. May we obtain the milking thereof".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Having performed the rite of the victimal cake, they thereupon proceed with the cakes to be offered at the (midday-)service.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: hotā yakṣad indraṃ marutvantam iti praiṣaḥ
translation: The formula for prompting the hotṛ to recite his offering-verse is: “Let the hotṛ worship Indra who is accompanied by the Maruts.”
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: As the offering-verse, he recites: “United with Maruts, O Indra, drink the Soma.”
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Having paṛtaken of this soma-draught, he recites the marutvatīya-śastra.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At the interior of a śastra, the call of the morning-service is applied.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaya iti prātipadaṃ tṛcaṃ śastvāhūya
translation: Having recited the beginning-triplet: “We make thee hither like a chariot, for aid,” he utters the call.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: idaṃ vaso sutam andha ity anucaraṃ tṛcaṃ śastvāhūya
translation: Having recited the antistrophe-triplet: “Drink this pressed herb, O Vasu,” he utters the call.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: indra nedīya ed ihītīndranihavaṃ pragāthaṃ śastvāhūya
translation: Having recited the pragātha to invite Indra: “O Indra, come nearer,” he utters the call.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatir iti brāhmaṇaspatyaṃ pragāthaṃ śastvāhūya
translation: Having recited the pragātha addressed to Brāhmaṇaspati: “Now speaks Brāhmaṇaspati,” he utters the call.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Having recited the single verse: “Agni is the leader,” he utters the call.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tvaṃ soma kratubhir ity ekāṃ śastvāhūya
translation: Having recited the single verse: “Then, O Soma, with insight,” he utters the call.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Having recited the single verse: “The Maruts swell the water,” he utters the call.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: janiṣṭhā ugra iti ṣaṭ chastvāhūya nividam
translation: Having recited six verses (of the principal hymn beginning): “Thou, the terrible one, hast been born,” he utters the call and recites the nivid.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At this hymn, the first responsive call (of the adhvaryu) contains a form of the word mad.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At hymns of an odd number of verses, he inserts the nivid after having recited the greater half.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the middle (he inserts it) at (hymns) of an even number of verses.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At triplets, after having recited one verse.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: If the number of hymns is increased, (he inserts the nivid) in the last (hymn).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: But the call is uttered (at the beginning of the) first.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At the afternoon-service, (he inserts the nivid) leaving over the last verses.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The nivids he recites separatingly, by verse-quarters.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: At the last verse-quarter, the prāṇava (is inserted).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sūktaśeṣaṃ śastvāhūyottamayā paridhāyokthavīryaṃ japitvā ye tvāhihatya iti yajati
translation: Having recited the remaining part of the hymn and having uttered the call, he closes the śastra with the last verse, mutters the “foṚce of the śastra,” and applies as the offering-verse: “Those who at the slaying of the dragon.”
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: unnīyamānebhya ity ukta ā tvā vahantu haraya ity unnīyamānasūktam
translation: When he (the maitrāvaruṇa) has been addressed (by the adhvaryu) with the words: “Recite to the (bowls) being filled’’, (be recites) the hymn for filling: “May the bay (steeds) carry thee hither’’.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: hotā yakṣad indraṃ prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyeti praiṣaḥ
translation: The (formula for) prompting (the hotṛ to recite his offeringverse for the libation for the filled bowls, which have been advanced) is: “Let the hotṛ worship Indra at morning from morning-service’’.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: idaṃ te somyaṃ madhv iti yajati
translation: He (the hotṛ) recites as offering-verse: “This sweet somadrink for thee".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā nṛcakṣāḥ pratīkṣa iti hotṛcamasaṃ pratīkṣya vayodhasaṃ tvā vayodhāḥ pratigṛhṇāmīti pratigṛhyoraḥ saṃsparśayati dvidevatyāṃś ca
translation: With (the formula): “To thee, who beholdest the men, I who behold the men, look forward” having looked it, he (the hotṛ) receives his bowl with (the formula): “The vigorous one, I being vigorous, receive’’, whereupon he touches with it his breast and the (three) bowls containing the Soma destined for the pair of deities.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Of the bowls, which again have been filled, the hotṛakas sacrifice (i.e., recite each the yājya for the sacrifice performed by the adhvaryu).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The maitrāvaruṇa (recites the offering-verse): "Mitra do we call and Varuṇa".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The brāhmaṇacchamsin: "O Indra, thou, the bull".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The potṛ: "0 Maruts, in whose abode".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The neṣṭṛ: "0 Agni, convey hither the wives".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The agnīdhra: "To Agni, whose food is the ox".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ayāḍ agnīd ity ukte 'yāḍ ity āgnīdhraḥ
translation: When it has been said (by the hotṛ): "Has the agnīdhra offered (i.e. recited his offering-verse)?" the agnīdhra (answers): "The agnīdh has offered (i.e. said his verse)".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sa bhadram akar yo naḥ somaṃ pāyayiṣyatīti hotā
translation: Then the hotṛ (says): "He has done a good thing, he who will cause us to drink the Soma".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He who has spoken the vaṣaṭ paṛtakes first.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pratibhakṣitaṃ dvidevatyaśeṣaṃ nārāśaṃsavatāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ hotṛcamase 'vanayati hute tvā bhakṣitam avanayāmy ūrjasvantaṃ devebhya āyuṣmantaṃ mahyam iti
translation: He pours the rest of the draughts destined for the pairs of deities, after the other has paṛtaken also from these into the bowl of the hotṛ with (the formula): "Thee, of whom has been paṛtaken, I pour out into the sacrificed, thee vigour-giving to the Gods, life-giving to me". The same must take place with the nārāśaṃsa-draughts.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Twice is poured out from the remains of the draught destined for Indra and Vāyu and here the mantra returns (is also said the second time).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Until the moment that (this) pouring out into the hotṛcamasa of the remains of the draught for the couple of deities has taken place, they do not let them go (out of their hand).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Then takes place) the sacrifice to Varuṇa.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: apsv agne 'psu me soma iti vāpsumantau
translation: Or the (verses with which the butter-portions are offered) are those containing the words 'in the water’: “In the water, O Agni”; “In the water my Soma”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: He performs the sacrifice standing.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The invīting- and offering-verses for the principal oblation are): “Loose the uppermost rope’’; “Thy wrath, O Varuṇa”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sa tvaṃ no agne 'vamas tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān ity agnīvaruṇāv ādiśati
translation: (By the two verses): “Be, O Agni, nearest to us”, “Do thou Agni appease the wrath of Varuṇa” he assigns Agni and Varuṇa.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Of the fore-offerings and the after-offerings the one to the sacrificial strew is left out.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.
Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or the two butter-portions and the two after-offerings may fall out.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yena striyāv akurutaṃ yenāpāmṛśataṃ surāṃ yenā kṣām abhyaṣiñcataṃ yenemāṃ pṛthivīṃ mahīṃ yad vāṃ tad aśvinā yaśas tena mām abhiṣiñcatam / iti hotābhyukṣate
translation: With (the verse): “By which glory the two made the two women, by which they touched the sura, by which they sprinkled the earth: this wide terrestrial world, which glory there is yours, O Aśvins, thereby sprinkle me" the hotṛ sprinkles himself (when coming out of the water of the lustral bath).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: upocchivena cakṣuṣā gṛhān paraimi mānuṣaḥ / ity āgacchan yajamānaḥ
translation: The sacrificer, whilst coming (out of the water and returning mutters) the (verse): "I, a human being, come to my dwelling with auspicious look”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: iho sahasradakṣiṇo api pūṣā ni ṣīdatu / ity upaviśyāhavanīye samidhāv ādadhāti devānāṃ samid asīti pūrvāṃ tūṣṇīm uttarām
translation: With (the verse) : "Nay Pūṣan, possessor of a thousand cows sit down here'' he sits down (on his usual sitting-place) and lays two fuel-sticks on the Āhāvaniya, the first with : "Thou art the fuel-stick of the Gods", the second without mantra.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The same does bis wife in the Gārhapatya without any mantra.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The (acts of the) morning-service (are performed) with a low (pitch of) voice.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Somewhat louder than the ājya(śastra) is the praüga (śastra).
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: With the middle (strength of) voice the midday-service.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Somewhat louder than the marutvatīya (is) the niṣkevalya.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: With the loudest voice the afternoon-service.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Or the midday service is with the loudest.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: hotā yakṣad devaṃ savitāram iti praiṣaḥ
translation: The (formula for) prompting (the hotṛ to recite the offering-verse) is: "Let the hotṛ worship the God Savitṛ”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: damūnā devaḥ savitā vareṇyo dadhad ratnaṃ dakṣapitṛbhya āyuni / pibāt somam amadann enam iṣṭayaḥ parijmā cid ramate asya dharmaṇi // iti yajati
translation: As offering-verse he applies: “May the household God, the delectable Savitṛ, assign treasures to the sons of wisdom, during their whole life. Let him drink the Soma, the oblations have exhilerated him, even the wanderer takes delight in his ordinance".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: adhvaryo śośoṃsāvo3 ity āhāvaḥ śastrādau tṛtīyasavane sokthe
translation: The call at the beginning of a śastra during the afternoon-service and the uktha-śastras runs: “O adhvaryu, sosomsavo3".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: In the middle of a śastra it is the same as at the morning-service.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: And also the ṣoḍaśin and the following sacrifices of Soma.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The (hymn) addressed to Savitṛ is: “The God hath become”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ekayā ca daśabhiś ca svabhūte dvābhyām iṣṭaye viṃśatī ca / tisṛbhiś ca vahase triṃśatā ca niyudbhir vāyav iha tā muñcaḥ
translation: (Then a verse addressed to Vāyu): “With one and ten for thine own sake, with two and twenty for worshipping, with three and thirty for conveying (the sacrifice to the Gods): with thy teams, O Vāyu do thou here unloose them”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī ṛtāvṛdheti dyāvāpṛthivīyam
translation: (Then the hymn addressed to sky and earth): “Forwards sky and earth with sacrifices”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The responsive call (of the adhvaryu) contains an expression with the word mad ("to rejoice").
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The one verse): "The maker of fair forms".
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Then the (hymn) to the Ṛbhus: "They have wrought the car”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ayaṃ veno yebhyo mātaivā pitra ity ekapātinyaḥ
translation: (Then come) the (three) isolated (verses): "This Vena”; "In whom the mother”; and "To the father”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The last (verse of this hymn) is the closing one.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: The third, he recites twice by verse-halves.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ukthavīryaṃ japitvā viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemam iti yajati
translation: Having muttered the formula designated as 'the strength of the śastra’, he applies as offering-verse: "Ye All-Gods, hearken to this my call”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agnīt pātnīvatasya yajety ukta aibhir agne saratham ity upāṃśu yajati
translation: When he (the agnīdhra) has been addressed (by the adhvaryu) with (the words): “Agnīdh, recite the offering-verse (for the oblation of the soma-draught) destined for (Agni) with the wives (of the Gods)” he (the agnīdhra) recites whisperingly the offering-verse: “With these, O Agni, on the same chariot come hither”.
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (The single) verse: “Let come hither, O Father of the Maruts'’

translation: Nun (werden wir das Ritual) für die Śrauta-Opfer (erklären). Der den Brahmaveda kennende Brahman setzt sich bei einer Opferhandlung nach der (im Kaus. sūtra 3. 5-7 gegebenen) Regel südlich (vom Vihāra), nichts Weltliches redend.

translation: Die (in diesem Sūtra) angegebenen Opferspenden begleitet er mit Vedasprüchen (d.h. nach jeder Spende hat er die jedesmal angegebene Strophe oder das jedesmal angegebene Lied zu flüstern).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910

text_iast: mantrānādeśe liṅgavateti bhāgaliḥ / prajāpate na tvad etāny anya iti yuvā kauśikaḥ / yathādevatam iti māṭharaḥ / oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad o3m ity ācāryāḥ
translation: Wenn ein Vedaspruch nicht dabei angegeben ist, dann mit einer (beliebigen Strophe,) welche das Stichwort (d.h. den Namen des Gegenstandes, auf welchen die Handlung sich bezieht) enthält, nach Bhāgalī; mit (der Strophe): "Prajāpati, kein anderer als du" (VII. 30. 3), nach Kauśika Junior; je nach der Gottheit (d.h. jedesmal mit einer Strophe, in welcher die Gottheit erwähnt wird, welcher die Spende oder die Handlung gilt), nach Māṭhara; mit den (heiligen) Worten: om, bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ, janad, om nach unserem Lehrer.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
