translation: Die vier Strophen (deren erste anfängt): "mir, o Agni, Glanz" (V. 3. 1-4) spricht er (der Opferherr) aus um die Götter für sich zu gewinnen. (Das Lied): "o Sinīvalī mit breiten Flechten" (VII. 46) (spricht er ausserdem, am Neumondstage, aus um sich der Gunst) der im Mantra genannten Gottheit (zu sichern).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: atha brahmāṇaṃ vṛṇīte bhūpate bhuvanapate bhuvāṃ pate mahato bhūtasya pate brahmāṇaṃ tvā vṛṇīmaha iti
translation: Jetzt wählt er (der Opferherr) sich den Brahman mit (der Formel), "o Herr der Welt, o Herr des Geschaffenen, o Herr der Welträume, o Herr der grossen Schöpfung, wir erwählen uns dich als Brahman."
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vṛto japaty ahaṃ bhūpatir ahaṃ bhuvanapatir ahaṃ bhuvāṃ patir ahaṃ mahato bhūtasya patis tad ahaṃ manase prabravīmi mano vāce vāg gāyatryai gāyatry uṣṇiha uṣṇig anuṣṭubhe 'nuṣṭub bṛhatyai bṛhatī paṅktaye paṅktis triṣṭubhe triṣṭub jagatyai jagatī prajāpataye prajāpatir viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad o3m iti apratirathaṃ ca
translation: Der Gewählte flüstert: "ich bin der Herr der Welt, ich der Herr des Geschaffenen, ich der Herr der Welträume, ich der Herr der grossen Schöpfung; das künde ich dem Geiste an, der Geist (kündet es) der Stimme (an), die Stimme der Gāyatrī, die Gāyatrī der Uṣṇih, die Uṣṇih der Anustubh, die Anustubh der Bṛhati, die Bṛhati der Pankti, die Pankti der Triṣṭubh, die Triṣṭubh der Jagatī, die Jagatī dem Prajāpati und der Prajāpati allen Göttern. om, bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ, janad, om" und (er flüstert) das Apratiratha-Lied (XIX. 13).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Die Serie von Handlungen (hat an diesem Moment Geltung), deren erste duṚch die Worte "mit strömendem Wasser sich den Mund gespült habend" angedeutet ist und die mit dem Vorwärtsschreiten schliesst.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: uttarato 'gner dakṣiṇato 'parāgnibhyāṃ prapadyāsādaṃ vīkṣyāhe daidhiṣavya ityādy ā dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ samīkṣaṇāt
translation: Nachdem er (der Brahman) nördlich vom (Āhāvaniya-)Feuer und westlich von (d.h. hinter) den beiden westlichen Feuern (Gārhapatya und Dakṣiṇagni) vorwärts getreten ist, schaut er auf seinen Sitz; (unmittelbar darauf gilt die Serie von Handlungen), deren erste das (Reden des Spruches:) "ach, du Sohn aus zweiter Heirat" und deren letzte das Anblicken von Himmel und Erde ist.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Jetzt das Anlegen der Feuer (die Gründung der zum vedischen Ritual erforderlichen Opferfeuer).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vasante brāhmaṇasya / grīṣme rājanyasya / varṣāsu vaiśyasya / trīṇi parvāṇīty uktam
translation: Im Frühling (findet es statt) für einen Brahmanen, im Sommer für einen Kṣatriya, in der Regenzeit für einen Vaiśya. Die (Kaus. sūtra 94. 7 gegebene Bestimmung:) "drei Zeitpunkte (gibt es)" gilt (auch hier).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Er darf die Feuer anlegen, wann er nur immer will, nur weiche der Glaube nicht von ihm.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Behandelt ist der Brahmaudana.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yo aśvatthaḥ śamīgarbha āruroha tve sacā / taṃ te harāmi brahmaṇā yajñiyaiḥ ketubhiḥ saha / jātavedo bhuvanasya yad reta iha siñca tapaso yaj janiṣyate / agnim aśvatthād adhi havyavāhaṃ śamīgarbhāj janayan yo mayobhūr iti mantrokte araṇī gṛhṇantam ādhāsyamānaṃ vācayati
translation: "Der mit Śamī verwachsene Asvattha, der mit dir (o Feuerbohrer) zusammen aufgewachsen ist, Den hol' ich dir mit heil'gem Spruch und Opferflammen." "O Jātavedas, den Samen der Welt giess' aus hier, der aus Erhitzung entstehen wird, Indem du aus Śamī-verwachsenem Asvattha das Opferspeise führende Feuer erzeugst, das wunderbare" (diese beide Strophen) heisst er (der Brahman) den (Opferherrn), der das Vornehmen hat sich die Feuer anzulegen, aussprechen, während er (der Opferherr) die beiden (Reibhölzer) von der Art (d.h. von der Holzsorte), wie im Spruche angedeutet ist, eṛgreift.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vāgyatā jāgrato rātrim āsate / pararātraṃ vā
translation: Die Stimme anhaltend (d. h. nichts Weltliches redend) bringen sie (der Opferherr, die Gattin und der Brahman) die Nacht oder den zweiten Teil der Nacht wachend duṚch.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Mit (der Strophe): "O Bṛhaspati, o Savitṛ" (VII. 16) wecke er (der Opferherr) die Schlafenden.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tenāgnipadam aśvaṃ snāpayann abhyukṣañchamayaty anudita udite vādhāsyamānaḥ

text_iast: yat tvā kruddhā ity upoddharanty ācāryāḥ / āhavanīyadakṣiṇāgnyor lakṣaṇāntam
translation: (Die Strophe): "was dich im Zorn" (XII. 3. 5) soll nach meinem Lehrer dabei ausgelassen werden. Für Āhāvaniya und Dakṣiṇagni (nur) bis zum Ziehen der Linien.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: purīṣyo 'si viśvabharāḥ / atharvā tvā prathamo nir amanthad agne / tvām agne puṣkarād adhy atharvā nir amanthata / mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ / tam u tvā dadhyaṅṅ ṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ / vṛtrahaṇaṃ puraṃdaram / tam u tvā pāthyo vṛṣā samīdhe dasyuhantamam / dhanaṃjayaṃ raṇe raṇa iti mathyamānam anumantrayate
translation: (Die beiden Strophen): "Lehmentsprungen bist du, alltragend; Atharvan hat dich, Agni, zuerst hervoṛgebohrt; Dich, Agni, hat Atharvan hervoṛgebohrt aus dem Lotus, der das Haupt von allem ist, er der Priester (?)." "Dich hat auch der Ṛṣi Dadhyanc, des Atharvan Sohn, dich, den Feindebesieger, Buṛgzerbrecher, Dich hat auch entfacht der Pathyā Vṛṣan, dich den mächtigen Feindetöter, der Gewinner von Habe in Kampf für Kampf" spricht er (der Brahman) aus, wenn es (das Gārhapatya-Feuer) gebohrt wird.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Wenn es (das Feuer aus den Araṇi's) entstanden ist, (so spricht er die Strophe): "den schön geborenen Jātavedas" (IV. 23. 4).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: jātarūpeṇāntardhāya / nāsikyenoṣmaṇāsyena vā / mayy agra ity etayāpānati
translation: (Ein Stückchen) Gold zwischen (sich und dem Feuer) haltend atmet er mit dem Hauch der Nase oder mit dem Munde (über dem Feuer) ein, nachdem er (die Strophe): "in mir zuerst" (VII. 82. 2) gesprochen hat.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: aśvapādaṃ lakṣaṇe nidhāpyamānaṃ sam adhvarāyety anumantrayate
translation: Wenn (der Adhvaryu) das Ross die Linien (der Feuerstätte des Āhāvaniya) betreten lässt, spricht er (der Brahman über dem Ross die Strophe): "der Opferhandlung" (III. 16. 1) aus.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Während das Feuer auf dem Wagen nach vorne (zur Feuerstätte) geführt wird, heisst er (der Brahman) den (Opferherrn), welcher das Ross von hinten angefasst hält, (die folgenden fünf Strophen) sagen:
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: yad akrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyant samudrād uta vā purīṣāt / śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te arvan / yad akrandaḥ salile jāto arvant sahasvān vājin balavān balena / taṃ tvādadhur brahmaṇe bhāgam agne atharvāṇaḥ sāmavedo yajūṃṣi / ṛgbhiḥ pūtaṃ prajāpatir atharvaṇe 'śvaṃ prathamaṃ nināya / tasya pade prathamaṃ jyotir ādadhe sa mā vahāti sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ / abhitiṣṭha pṛtanyato mahyaṃ prajām āyuś ca vājin dhehi / tvayā vadheyaṃ dviṣataḥ sapatnān svargaṃ me lokaṃ yajamānāya dhehi / abhitiṣṭha pṛtanyataḥ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ / yathāham abhibhūḥ sarvāṇi tāni dhūrvato janān iti
translation: "Als du wiehertest sogleich bei deiner Geburt, dich erhebend aus Meer oder aus Lehm, Eines Adlers Schwingen, einer Gazelle Füsse, preiswert ist deine hohe Geburt, o Renner!" "Als du wiehertest in der Flut geboren, Renner, stark, o Ross, kräftig an Kraft, Da bestimmten dich zu Anfang dem Brahman zu Anteil der Atharva-, der Sama- und der Yajurveda." "Das mit Ṛgversen gereinigte Ross führte zuerst Prajāpati dem Atharvan zu Auf seinem Schritt hat er zuerst das Feuer sich angelegt, das möge mich führen zu der Welt der Frommen." "Betrete die Feinde, verleihe mir Nachkommen und langes Leben, o Ross. Möge ich duṚch dich die mich hassenden Nebenbuhler töten. Verleihe mir, dem Opferherrn, die Himmelswelt." "Betrete die Feinde, bewältige die Anfeindenden Damit ich überlegen sei den Leuten, die hier alles schädigen."
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: āhavanīyadakṣiṇāgnī gārhapatyāt saha praṇīyamāṇau vyākaromīty anumantrayate
translation: Wenn Āhāvaniya und Dakṣiṇagni zusammen aus dem Gārhapatya nach vorne gebracht (d. h. entnommen) werden, so spricht er (der Brahman) darüber (die Strophe): "ich trenne" (XII. 2. 32) aus.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: āhitam āhavanīyam āyaṃ gaur ity upatiṣṭhate
translation: Das angelegte Āhāvaniya-Feuer redet er (der Brahman), indem er davor stehend darauf hinblickt, mit (der Strophe): "heran dieser Stier" (VI. 31. 1) an.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Der Dakṣiṇagni ist duṚch Feuerbohren herzustellen oder (von iṛgend woher) herbeizuholen.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sabhyāvasathyayor āhavanīyād vihāraḥ / sabhyād vāvasathyasya / sabhyaḥ sabhāyai / āvasathya āvasathāya
translation: Das Sabhya- und das Āvaṣaṭhya-Feuer sind dem Āhāvaniya zu entnehmen, oder das Āvaṣaṭhya dem Sabhya. Das Sabhya-Feuer gilt für die Sabhā (Versammlungs- und Spielhalle), das Āvaṣaṭhya für das Haus.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: agnipadam aśvaṃ rathaṃ cātuṣprāśyāṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca brahmaṇe dadāti
translation: Das Ross "Feuerfuss", der Wagen, die Kuh mit deren Milch das Brahmaudana bereitet war und das Gold gibt er (der Opferherr) dem Brahman.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: indrasyaujo marutām anīkam iti ratham abhi hutvā vanaspate vīḍvaṅga ity ātiṣṭhati
translation: Nachdem er auf den Wagen eine (Butter)spende mit (der Strophe): "Indras Kraft der Maruts Zug" (VI. 125. 3) ausgegossen, besteigt er denselben mit der Strophe: "o Holz, starkgliedrig" (VI. 125. 1).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Darauf setzt er (der Brahman) sich (an seinem gewöhnlichen Ort) nieder und (spricht) über der Volllöffelspende, (die vom Adhvaryu daṛgebracht wird, die Strophe): "mit Verehrung dich" (III. 15. 17).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: idam ugrāyety anvaktān akṣān videvanāyādhvaryave prayacchati
translation: Nachdem er (der Brahman, mit der Strophe): "dies dem Gewaltigen" (VII. 109. 1) die Würfel mit Butter bestrichen hat, überreicht er dieselben (dem Adhvaryu) zum Verspielen (der Kuh).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: āgnyādheyikīṣv iṣṭiṣv agneḥ pavamānasya pāvakasya śucer aditer iti pavamānaḥ punātu tveṣas te agnī rakṣāṃsy aditir dyaur iti
translation: Bei den Iṣṭis, die zur Gelegenheit der Feueṛgründung verrichtet werden, an Agni Pavamana, Agni Pāvaka, Agni śuci und Aditi, (verwendet er zum Anumantraṇa nach den Hauptspenden dieser Iṣṭis hintereinander die folgenden Strophen): "der Pavamana läutere" (VI. 19. 2), "dein mächtiger" (XVIII. 4. 59), "Agni die Rakṣas" (VIII. 3. 20) und "Aditi ist Himmel" (VII. 6. 1).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Der Opferherr (soll darauf) während zwölf Tage die Vorschriften (beachten, welche im Kaus. sūtra 1. 31-34 duṚch das Wort:) "die Fastenspeise" (angedeutet sind).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Keuschheit und die Observanzen betrachtend schläft er am Boden in der Nähe der Feuer.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Die Strophe): "Glut bist du" (XVII. 1. 21) flüstert er (der Brahman) unmittelbar nachdem der Gharma (d. h. der Mahāvīra, der Pravaṛgya-Topf) in Glut versetzt ist.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Wenn sie (d. h. der Adhvaryu cum suis) aufstehen um die Kuh, welche die Milch für das Pravaṛgya-Zeremoniell liefern wird, zu melken, (so spricht der Brahman) über ihnen (das Lied): "stehet auf, blicket hin" (VII. 72).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: (Die Strophe), "ich rufe herbei" (VII. 73. 7) (spricht er) über der Gharma-Kuh.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: gharmasūktena gharmaṃ hūyamānam / svāhākṛta iti dvābhyāṃ gharmasya vaṣaṭkṛte 'nuvaṣaṭkṛte
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Wenn (die Strophe): "infolge guter Weide" (RS I. 164. 40) dreimal (vom Hotr) gesagt ist, (bringt der Brahman) seine Schlussspenden (dar).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910

translation: (Das Lied): "bei Abend singe" (VI. 1) flüsternd blickt er (der Brahman) den Udgātṛ an.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910

text_iast: stotropākaraṇāt prastotā brahmāṇam āmantrayate brahman stoṣyāmaḥ praśāsta iti
translation: Ladet nach der "Eintreibung" des Stotra der Prastotṛ den Brahman ein, (seine Erlaubnis zu geben) und zwar indem er sagt: "Brahman, wir wollen das Lob halten, o Praśāstṛ!",
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tatra raśmir asi kṣayāya tvā kṣayaṃ jinva / savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta / deva savitar etat te prāha tat pra ca suva pra ca yaja / āyuṣmatyā ṛco māpagāyata tanūpāt sāmnaḥ / satyā va āśiṣaḥ santu satyā ākūtayaḥ / ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ca vadata / bṛhaspate 'numatyoṃ bhūr janad indravanta ity uktvā stuteti prathamayā svaramātrayā prasauti / madhyamayā mādhyaṃdine / uttamayā tṛtīyasavane
translation: so erlässt er (der Brahman) seine Aufforderung, indem er flüstert: "Zügel bist du; zur Herrschaft dich; die Herrschaft fördere. Auf Savitṛ's Geheiss haltet das Lob dem Bṛhaspati; Gott Savitṛ, dies kündige ich dir an, das betreibe und bringe dar. Von der Leben-enthaltenden Rede weichet beim Singen nicht ab, (nicht) vom Körperschirmenden Sāman! Verwirklichen sollen sich eure Wünsche, verwirklichen sich eure Vorsätze. Sprechet Rechtes und Wahres. O Bṛhaspati, mit (deiner) Einwilligung, om, bhur, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ. Mit Indra vereint," — und dann in der schwächsten Tonstärke sagt: "lobet!" in mittlerer Tonstärke bei der Mittagkelterung, in stäṛkster bei der dritten Kelterung.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: bhuva iti mādhyaṃdine / svar iti tṛtīyasavane
translation: Mit "... bhuvaḥ" (statt bhur der Formel aus Sūtra 4) bei der Mittagkelterung, mit "svaḥ" bei der dritten Kelterung.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ukthyādiṣv ahīne ca oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad vṛdhat karad ruhan mahat tac cham om iti ca
translation: Beim Ukthya und den anderen (Grundformen des Soma-Opfers) mit ein bhur bhuvaḥ svar janad; vṛdhad; karad; rūhad; mahad, taccham om.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: viṣpardhamānayoḥ savṛtasomayoḥ stomabhāgānām uparyupari stuteṣe stutorje stuta devasya savituḥ save / bṛhaspatiṃ vaḥ prajāpatiṃ vo vasūn vo devān rudrān vo devān ādityān vo devān sādhyān vo devān āptyān vo devān viśvān vo devān sarvān vo devān viśvatas parihavāmahe / janebhyo 'smākam astu kevala itaḥ kṛṇotu vīryam iti japan pareṣāṃ brahmāṇam avekṣeta
translation: Für den Fall, dass zwei Nebenbuhler zu gleicher Zeit ein Soma-Opfer anstellen, flüstere er (der Brahman jedesmal) außer den Stomabhāgas: "haltet das Lob zur Erquickung, haltet das Lob zur Labe, haltet das Lob auf Geheiss des Gottes Savitṛ. Den Bṛhaspati, den Prajāpati, die Vasus, die Rudras, die Ādityas, die Sādhyas, die Aptyas, die Allgötter, alle die Götter rufen wir von allen Seiten. Unseren Leuten gehöre er ausschließlich an, hier verleihe er uns Macht" und blicke dabei nach dem Brahman der feindlichen Partei hin.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: stutasya stutam asy ūrjasvat payasvat / ūrjaṃ mahyaṃ stutaṃ duhām ā mā stutasya stutaṃ gamet / indriyāvanto havāmahe dhukṣīmahi prajām iṣam / sā me satyāśīr deveṣv astu / brahmavarcasaṃ mā gamayed iti stotram anumantrayate
translation: Wenn das Lob beendigt ist, flüstert er (der Brahman die Formel): "des Lobes Lob bist du, labe- und saftreich. Labung soll mir das Lob zumelken! Her zu mir möge kommen des Lobes Lob. Kraft besitzend rufen wir (es); mögen wir uns Nachkommen und Lebenskraft zumelken! Dieser Wunsch soll mir unter den Göttern verwirklicht sein! Priesterliches Ansehen möge es mir zukommen lassen!"
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: indrasya kukṣir ity āsikte some pūtabhṛtam
translation: (Die Strophe): "Indras Raub" (VII. 111) (spricht der Brahman aus) über dem Pūtabhṛt, wenn der Soma (vom Neṣṭṛ darin) gegossen ist.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Diejenigen, die das sekundäre Brāhmaṇa als Autorität erkennen, (verwenden hier) die im Brāhmaṇa gegebenen (Formeln).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: athādhvaryur āhāgnīd agnīn vihara barhi stṛṇīhi paroḍāśān alaṃkurv iti
translation: Sagt jetzt der Adhvaryu: "Agnīdh, nimm die Feuer aus, streue die Streu, mache die Opferkuchen zurecht",
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Daselbst (auf die genannten Dhiṣṇyas) gießt er (Schmalz oder Soma) nach.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Der Rückenlinie (der Mahavedi) entlang streut er (vom Gārhapatya bis zum Āhāvaniya) Streu hin und macht die Opferkuchen zurecht.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ye agnayo vihṛtā dhiṣṇyāḥ pṛthivīm anu / te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas te no mā hiṃsiṣur iti vihṛtān anumantrayate / uttarayoḥ savanayoḥ punar maitv indriyam iti / āhavanīyam apareṇetyuktam
translation: Über den (vom Āgnīdhra über die Dhiṣṇyas) verteilten (Feuern) spricht er (der Brahman, die Formel) aus: "Die die Erde entlang über den Dhiṣṇyas verteilten Feuer, die sollen uns schützen, die uns helfen. Ihnen Verehrung! die sollen uns nicht verletzen" (so bei der Moṛgenkelterung). Bei den letzten zwei (der mittäglichen und der dritten) Kelterungen (die Strophe): "wieder soll zu mir kommen der Mut" (VII. 67). Behandelt (und an diesem Augenblick zu verrichten ist) die Handlung, welche duṚch (die Worte): "hinter dem Āhāvaniya" angedeutet ist.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pravṛtāḥ pravṛtāhutīr juhvati juṣṭo vāce bhūyāsaṃ juṣṭo vācaspataye devi vāg yad vāco madhumattamaṃ tasmin mā dhāḥ svāhā / vāce svāhā vācaspataye svāhā sarasvatyai svāheti / manasā caturthīm
translation: Die erwählten (Priester) bringen die (vier) "Wahlspenden" dar mit (den Formeln): "wohlgefällig möge ich der Vāc sein, wohlgefällig dem Vācaspati! o Göttin Vāc, was der Rede süßestes ist, darin mögest du mich stellen, svaḥa" "der Vāc, svaḥa" (2); "dem Vācaspati, svaḥa" "der Sarasvatī, svaḥa" die(se) vierte (Spende) in Gedanken.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: saptāhutīr ity eke sarasvate svāhā mahobhyaḥ sammahobhyaḥ svāhā / ṛcā stomam iti
translation: Sieben Spenden (bringen sie) nach einigen (dar) mit (den Formeln): "dem Sarasvant, svaḥa" (5); "den großen, allgroßen, svaḥa" (6); "mit der Strophe das Stotra" (7) (Kaus. sūtra 5. 7).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vapāmārjanānta upotthāya divas pṛṣṭha ity ādityam upatiṣṭhante
translation: Beim Abschluss der (Darbringung der) Netzhaut (vom Savanīyapasu) und des (darauffolgenden) Händewaschens (der Beteiligten) stehen sie (der Brahman cum suis und der Opferherr) auf und richten sich an die Sonne mit (der Strophe): "auf des Himmels Rücken" (XIII. 2. 27).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: mā pragāmety āvrajyāhavanīyaṃ nirmathyaṃ yūpam ādityam agnayaḥ sagarā stha sagareṇa nāmnā raudreṇānīkena pāta māgnayaḥ pipṛta māgnayo gopāyata mā namo vo 'stu mā mā hiṃsiṣṭeti
translation: Nachdem sie mit der Strophe: "nicht wollen wir fortgehen" (XIII. 1. 59) herangeschritten sind, (richten sie sich an) das Āhāvaniya(-Feuer), an das Nirmanthya(-Feuer), den Pfosten und die Sonne mit (der Formel): "Ihr Feuer, Sagara seid ihr, Sagara mit Namen; mit eurer Rudra-Erscheinung beschützet mich, rettet mich, o Feuer! Behaltet mich! Verehrung euch! Nicht verletzet mich".
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Nördlich um das Agnīdhriya hin begeben sie sich zum Sadas.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: dhiṣṇyavanto yajamānaś ca pūrvayā dvārā prasarpanti / apare 'parayā
translation: Diejenigen (Priester), die ein Dhiṣṇya haben, und der Opferherr treten hinein (ins Sadas) duṚch die vordere, die anderen duṚch die hintere Tür.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sadaḥ prasṛpsyanto dhiṣṇyān namaskurvanti dhiṣṇyebhyo namo nama iti
translation: Wenn sie im Begriff stehen in das Sadas hineinzutreten, erweisen sie den Dhiṣṇyas Verehrung mit (den Worten): "den Dhiṣṇyas Verehrung, Verehrung".
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: draṣṭre nama iti draṣṭāraṃ prasarpantaḥ / upaśrotre nama ity upaśrotāram
translation: Beim Hineintreten (in das Sadas) (erweisen sie) duṚch (die Worte): "dem Zuschauer Verehrung" dem Zuschauer (ihre Verehrung), "dem Zuhörer Verehrung", dem Zuhörer.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: cātvālotkaraśāmitrovadhyagohāstāvāgnīdhrīyācchāvākavādaṃ mārjālīyaṃ kharaṃ dhiṣṇyān anyāṃś copatiṣṭhante agnayaḥ sagarā stheti
translation: Den Cātvāla, den Utkara, das Śamītra(-Feuer), den Uvadhyagūha, den Āstāva, das Agnīdhriya(-Feuer), die Stelle wo der Acchāvāka reden wird, das Mārjalīya, den Khara, die Dhiṣṇyas und die anderen (Lokalitäten) reden sie (vor dem Sadas stehend) nach jedem hinblickend an mit (der Formel): "Ihr Feuer, Sagara seid ihr" (u.s.w. wie oben, 8).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: urv antarikṣaṃ vīhīti sado 'bhimṛśanti / devī dvārau mā mā saṃtāptaṃ lokaṃ me lokakṛtau kṛṇutam iti dvārye
translation: Mit (der Formel): "geh' hin zum weiten Luftraum" berühren sie das Sadas; mit (der Formel): "o göttliche Tür, beknelle mich nicht, du Platzmacher, mache mir Platz" die beiden Türpfosten.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: prasṛpya anukhyātre nama ity anukhyātāram / uttareṇa dhiṣṇyān parikramya svaṃ svaṃ dhiṣṇyam abhiprasṛptā upadraṣṭre nama ity upadraṣṭāram
translation: Nachdem sie (in das Sadas) hineingetreten sind, (erweisen sie) duṚch (die Formel): "dem Betrachter Verehrung" dem Betrachter (ihre Verehrung). Nachdem sie nördlich um die Dhiṣṇyas herumgegangen sind und jeder an sein eigenes Dhiṣṇya herangetreten ist, (erweisen sie) mit (der Formel): "dem Zuschauer Verehrung" dem Zuschauer (ihre Verehrung).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: upaviśya japanty abhi tvendreti / stotraṃ yajamānaḥ
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: sadasyo brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇena / stotrānumantraṇāj janad iti manasā
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: visaṃsthite yathādhiṣṇyam uttareṇa pūrvayā dvārā niṣkrāmanti / maitrāvaruṇadhiṣṇyam adhiṣṇyavantaḥ
translation: Solange ein Savana (die moṛgendliche, mittägliche und dritte Kelterung) nicht beendigt ist, begeben sich diejenigen, die ein Dhiṣṇya haben (wenn ihre Anwesenheit im Havirdhāna oder sonst iṛgendwo nötig ist), jeder nördlich um sein Dhiṣṇya hin duṚch die vordere Tür (des Sadas aus dem Sadas) hinaus; diejenigen, die kein Dhiṣṇya haben, (nördlich um) das Dhiṣṇya des Maitravaruna (hin).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ṣaḍahe 'bhiplavavad ājyastotriyāḥ / prathamayor āvāpaḥ pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpau ca
translation: Im (Pṛṣṭhya-)ṣaḍaha (sind) die Stotriya(-Tṛcas) für das Ājya(-śastra des Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin aller sechs Tage dieselben wie beim Abhiplava(-ṣaḍaha)); für die beiden ersten (Tage sind) das eingelegte Stück und die Stotriya- und Anurūpa(-Tṛcas) des Pṛṣṭha(-śastra) des Brāhmaṇaācchaṃsin dieselben).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Am dritten (Tage des Pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍaha ist der Āvāpa, d. h. das einzulegende Stück, beim Ājyaśastra) das fünfstrophige: "in den Kämpfen sei siegreich" (XX. 19. 6-20. 3).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Am vierten (Tage) die neun (Strophen): "des vielgepriesenen mit hundert Weisen" (XX. 19. 4-20. 6).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pañcame yad indrāhaṃ yathā tvam iti pañcadaśa
translation: Am fünften (Tage) die fünfzehn (Strophen): "wenn ich, o Indra, gleich wie du" (XX. 27—29).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ṣaṣṭhe abhi pra gopatiṃ girety ekaviṃśatiḥ
translation: Am sechsten (Tage) die einundzwanzig: "dem Rinderherrn jubele zu mit dem Liede" (XX. 92),
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: tṛtīyādīnāṃ vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta iti pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpāḥ
translation: Für den dritten Tag und die folgenden Tage (des Pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍaha sind) die Stotriya- und Anurūpa(-Tṛcas) zum Pṛṣṭha(śastra des Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin die Strophen, deren erste anfängt): "wir ja die den Soma besitzen" (XX. 52-57. 6).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: caturthe tubhyed imā savanā śūra viśveti ṣaṭ purastāt saṃpātāt / tisro 'rdharcaśaḥ
translation: Am vierten (Tage legt der Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin zu demselben Śastra) vor dem Sampāta-Lied die sechs (Strophen ein, deren erste anfängt): "dir alle diese Kelterungen, Held" (XX. 73), die (ersten) drei halbstrophenweise.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pañcame yac ciddhi satya somapā iti pāṅktaṃ saptarcam / dvau dvāv avasāya pañcamaṃ saṃtanoti / trayaṃ vāvasāya dvayam
translation: Am fünften (Tage legt der Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin) das siebenstrophige Paṅkti(-Lied ein): "wenn wir dir immer, wahrhafter Somatrinker" (XX. 74). Jedesmal nach zwei Pādas absetzend schliesst er den fünften an, oder nach drei absetzend (schliesst er) die letzten zwei (an).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ṣaṣṭhe vi tvā tatasre mithunā avasyava iti sapta / padānām ekaikam avasāya dvayaṃ saṃtanoti / dvayam avasāya dvayam
translation: Am sechsten Tage (legt der Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin immer zu demselben Śastra das Lied ein): "es haben dich bestürmt zu Paaren die Hülfesuchenden" (XX. 75). Von den sieben Pādas rezitiert er jedesmal einen, setzt ab und schliesst zwei (Pādas) an; dann setzt er nach zweien ab und (schliesst) die (letzten) zwei an.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vane na vā yo nyadhāyi cākan ity aṣṭarcaṃ ca
translation: und das achtstrophige (Lied): "der im Holze ist oder auch nicht ist niedeṛgesetzt und sich's gefallen liess" (XX. 76).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: ṣaṣṭhe imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāma hatvāya devā asurān yad āyan iti dvaipadau pacchaḥ
translation: Am sechsten (Tage des Pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍaha sind Stotriya und Anurūpa-Tṛcas für das Ukthaśastra des Brāhmaṇaācchaṃsin) die zwei (folgenden) aus Halbstrophen bestehenden (Strophen, die) Pāda für Pāda (zu nehmen sind): "diese Welten nun wollen wir gedeihen lassen" (XX. 63. 1 und 2 a b) und "wie die Götter kamen, nachdem sie die Asuras getötet" (XX. 63. 2 c—3).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: apendra prāco maghavann amitrān iti sukīrtim / caturthīm ardharcaśaḥ
translation: (Zu demselben Śastra legt der Brāhmaṇaācchaṃsin) das Sukīrti(-Lied ein): "fort unsere Feinde, freigebiger Indra, nach vorne" (XX. 125), die vierte (Strophe desselben sagt er) halbstrophenweise.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vi hi sotor asṛkṣateti vṛṣākapim / padāvagrāham anavānaṃ dvitīyeṣv avasyati / tṛtīyeṣu dvitīyāntyasvarayos tadādyoś ca nyūṅkhaninardān kṛtvā dvayaṃ saṃtanoti
translation: (Darauf) das Vṛṣākapi(-Lied): "das Keltern haben sie ja aufgegeben" (XX. 126), Pāda für Pāda absetzend, ohne eine Pause zum Einatmen zu machen; nach dem zweiten Pāda jeder (Strophe) setzt er ab; im dritten Pāda jeder (Strophe) nimmt er mit dem zweiten und letzten Vokal und in den beiden (o-Reihen), welche mit den eben genannten Vokalen anheben, den Nyuṅkha und Ninarda vor, und schliesst darauf das (letzte) Pāda-paar an.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: nyūṅkhapratigareṣu prathamacaturthāṣṭamadvādaśeṣu plutiḥ / ninardeṣv ādyatṛtīyayoḥ / madhyamaḥ svaritaḥ
translation: Im Nyuṅkha und im Pratigara tritt beim ersten, vierten, achten und zwölften (o) Plutierung ein; im Ninarda beim ersten und dritten, der mittlere ist svaritiert.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

translation: Zum Beispiel:
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: vi hi sotor asṛkṣata nendraṃ devam amaṃsata / yatro3 o o o3 o o o o3 o o o o3 madad vṛṣākapo3 o o3 aryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmād indra uktarom / parā hīndreti
translation: vi hi sotor asṛkṣata nendraṃ devam amaṃsata | yatro3 o o o3 ooo3 ooo3 madad vṛṣākapo3 oo3 āryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ parā hindra (u. s. w.).
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910
boundary_note: Supplementary evidence ABOUT a rite. Not part of any of the four core Samhita recensions and not counted into them.

text_iast: pratigare o3 o o o3 o o o o3 o o o o3 / ninardasya madetha madaivo3 o o3 thāmo daiveti
translation: Im Pratigara: o3 ooo3 ooo3 ooo3 | . Für den Ninarda ist der Pratigara madetha madaivoo3thāmo daiva.
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910

text_iast: idaṃ janā upa śruteti kuntāpam ardharcaśaḥ / caturdaśa padāvagrāham

translation: [*16]. He then makes them look at each other (while the bridegroom repeats the verses), 'With no evil eye, not bringing death to thy husband, bring luck to the cattle, be full of joy and vigour. Give birth to heroes; be godly and friendly. Bring us luck, to men and animals. 'Soma has acquired (thee) first (as his wife); after him the Gandharva has acquired (thee). Thy third husband is Agni; the fourth is thy human husband. 'Soma has given thee to the Gandharva; the Gandharva has given thee to Agni. Wealth and children Agni has given to me, and besides this wife. 'Pushan! Lead her to us, the highly blessed one. Sa na uru usati vihara, yasyam usantah praharama sepam yasyam u kama bahavo nivishtya (nivishta?) iti.'

text_iast: ā te yoniṃ garbha etu pumān bāṇa iveṣudhim / ā vīro atra jāyatāṃ putras te daśamāsyaḥ
translation: [*6]. Or, 'May a male embryo enter thy womb, as an arrow the quiver; may a man be born here, a son after ten months. 'Give birth to a male child; may after him (another) male be born; their mother shalt thou be, of the born, and (to others) mayst thou give birth. 'In the male verily, in the man dwells the sperm; he shall pour it forth into the woman: thus has said Dhatar, thus Pragapati has said. 'Pragapati has created him, Savitar has shaped him. Imparting birth of females to other (women) may he put here a man. 'From the auspicious sperms which the men produce for us, produce thou a son; be a well-breeding cow. 'Roar, be strong, put into her an embryo, achieve it; a male, thou male, put into her; to generation we call thee. 'Open thy womb; take in the man's sperm; may a male child be begotten in the womb. Him thou shalt bear; (having dwelt) ten months in the womb may he be born, the most excellent of his kin.'

translation: Turning to the sun he addresses it reverentially with (the formulas): "Self-existent art thou, the best ray of light! Life-bestowing art thou, give me (long) life. Splendour-bestowing art thou. Give me splendour. Body-protecting art thou, protect my body! Here I expel my spiteful enemy from these quarters, from this sky, from this intermediate region, from this food, from this standing-place. Expelled is the spiteful enemy". With (the formulas): "I make the turn of Indra", "I turn myself with Āditya's turning", he turns himself along his right arm (as axle). He then goes turning himself against the course of the sun (and addresses) the Gārhapatya with (the formulas): "O householder Agni, may I become a good householder through thee O Agni, the householder. Mayest thou, O Agni, become a good householder through me, O Agni, the householder. May our household-matters be unlike a cart drawn by only one bullock for a hundred winters for me from the side of so and so" and here he pronounces (instead of so and so) the names of his son(s). With (the formula: "bhūḥ bhuvaḥ svaḥ! Unite me with my desire" he touches the embers (of this fire). Then having muttered (the verse): "The sacrifice came to be, it came into existence, it was propagated and it increased again. It became the overlord of the Gods Let it make us overlords" he sips water in the same manner (as described), with (the formula): "O Agni, lord of observances, I have undeṛtaken the observance. I have been equal to it. I have been successful in it. I now am he that I am" puts a stick of fuel into the Āhāvaniya and thereby lets his voice free.

translation: If the sacrificial material (e.g. the milk for the agnihotṛa) has been spilt, he should pour water thereon with (the two verses): "May this praise fetch you hither, O Maruts"; and "By whose vigour the spheres were propped up, who are in strength the strongest and mightiest; who sway with powers unresisted, to Viṣṇu and Varuṇa it has gone at the first calling". translation: [*1]. 'Stand here, O post, firm, rich in horses and cows, . . . .; stand safely, dropping ghee; stand here, fixed in the ground, prosperous, long-lasting(?), amid the prosperity of people who satiate themselves. 'Stand fast in the Rathantara; recline on the Vamadevya; establish thyself on the Brihat'--with (these texts) he touches the chief post.

text_iast: tāñ juhoti saṃhatena tiṣṭhatī aryamaṇaṃ devaṃ kanyā agnim ayakṣata / sa no aryamā devaḥ preto muñcatu mā pateḥ svāhā / iyaṃ nāry upabrūte lājān āvapantikā / āyuṣmān astu me patir edhantāṃ jñātayo mama svāhā / imāṃl lājān āvapāmy agnau samṛddhikaraṇaṃ tava / mama tubhyaṃ ca saṃvananaṃ tad agnir anumanyatām iyaṃ svāheti
translation: [*2]. This she sacrifices, with firmly joined hands, standing, (while the bridegroom recites the verses,) 'To the god Aryaman the girls have made sacrifice, to Agni; may he, god Aryaman, loosen us from here, and not from the husband. Svaha! 'This woman, strewing grains, prays thus, "May my husband live long; may my relations be prosperous." Svaha! 'These grains I throw into the fire: may this bring prosperity to thee, and may it unite me with thee. May Agni grant us that. N.N.! Svaha!'

translation: [*3]. He then seizes her right hand together with the thumb, with (the verses), 'I seize thy hand for the sake of happiness, that thou mayst live to old age with me, thy husband. Bhaga, Aryaman, Savitri, Purandhi, the gods have given thee to me that we may rule our house. 'This am I, that art thou; that art thou, this am I. The Saman am I, the Rik thou; the heaven I, the earth thou. 'Come! Let us marry. Let us unite our sperm. Let us beget offspring. Let us acquire many sons, and may they reach old age. 'Loving, bright, with genial minds may we see a hundred autumns, may we live a hundred autumns, may we hear a hundred autumns!'

text_iast: namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śoṣāya / namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya / namo vaḥ pitaro balāya namo vaḥ pitaromṛtyave / namo vaḥ pitaro manyave namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai / namo vaḥ pitaraḥ pitaro namo vaḥ / ye 'tra pitaraḥ pitaraḥ stha yūyaṃ teṣāṃ śreṣṭhā bhūyāstha / ya iha pitaro manuṣyā vayaṃ teṣāṃ śreṣṭhā bhūyāsma / yā atra pitaraḥ svadhā yuṣmākaṃ sā / ya iha pitara edhatur asmākaṃ sa / gṛhān naḥ pitaroḍatta iti
translation: (He now pays homage to the Fathers with formula): "Homage to you, O Fathers, for life. Homage to you, O Fathers, for dryness. Homage to you, O Fathers, for the terrible. Homage to you, O Fathers, for sap. Homage to you, O Fathers, for strength. Homage to you, O Fathers, for death. Homage to you, O Fathers, for ardour. Homage to you, O Fathers, for well-being. Homage to you, O Fathers. O Fathers, homage to you. May ye, O Fathers, who are there Fathers, be the chief one of those, may we, O Fathers, be the chief ones of the men who are here. The well-being (svadhā), O Fathers, which is there, that be yours; the prosperity that is here, O Fathers, that be ours. Grant us a house."

translation: They should apply (for the brahmasaman at the pṛṣṭhalauds) thirty-three pragāthas; thirty-three in number are the deities; in the deities even they have (in this manner) continually a firm support. They should apply twenty-four: the year consists of twenty-four half-months; in the year even they have continually a firm support. They should apply twelve: the year consists of twelve months; in the year even they have continually a firm support. They should apply six: six in number are the seasons; in the seasons they have continually a firm support. They should apply four: four-footed is cattle; in the cattle they have continually a firm support. They should apply three: three are these worlds; in these worlds they have continually a firm support. They should apply two: two-footed is the Sacrificer, for treading on the world of heaven; for, in walking, man stands firmly now on this, now on that foot.

text_iast: agnaye samidham ahārṣaṃ bṛhate jātavedase / sa me śraddhāṃ ca medhāṃ ca jātavedāḥ prayacchatu svāhā / edho 'sy edhiṣīmahi samid asi tejo 'si tejo mayi dhehi svāhā / samiddho māṃ samardhaya prajayā ca dhanena ca svāhā / eṣā te agne samit tayā vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva / vardhiṣīmahi ca vayam ā ca pyāsiṣīmahi svāheti
translation: [*4]. (And puts fuel on the fire with the texts,) 'To Agni I have brought a piece of wood, to the great Gatavedas; may he, Gatavedas, give faith and insight to me. Svaha! 'Firewood art thou; may we prosper. Fuel art thou; splendour art thou; put splendour into me. Svaha! 'Being inflamed make me prosperous in offspring and wealth. Svaha! Thine is this fuel, Agni; thereby thou shalt grow and gain vigour. And may we grow and gain vigour. Svaha!'

translation: When the after-offerings have been performed, he shoves asunder the two (sacrificial) ladles: with the right hand of which the palm is turned downwards the juhū eastwards with (the formula): "May I be victorious after the victory of Agni, (of) Agni and Soma. Through the instigation of vigour I shove myself on"; with the left hand of which the palm is turned upwards the upabhṛt westwards with (the formula): "May Agni, (may) Agni and Soma push him away who hates us and whom we hate. Through the instigation of vigour I shove him away".

translation: The sacrificial cake, when it is laid down on the strew, he touches with (the formula): "Ruddy one, swell! Protect my breath. Protect my progeny. Protect my cattle. Thou art the fixing of the regions. Let the regions be fixed for me. Fixed for me be the regions. In these, being fixed, may I prosper. Here, ye Fathers, regale yourselves. translation: Having touched (the lustral boiling water) they pass before the Āhāvanlya and whilst touching the stalks of the Soma they make him swell by reciting (the following verses): “May stalk on stalk of thee, O God Soma, swell for Indra, the winner of a part of the riches. May Indra swell for thee, do thou swell for Indra. Make to swell us, the friends; through gain and wisdom. May I attain prosperously, O God Soma, the conclusion, the pressing of thee’’.

translation: Nachdem sie dieses (Wasser) mit den Händen berührt haben, machen sie (die Opferpriester und der Opferherr) den Soma "schwellen", indem sie (die folgenden Strophen) sprechen: "Spross für Spross soll dir, o König Soma, schwellen für Indra, der Reichtum gewinnt; Für dich soll Indra schwellen, schwelle du für Indra." "Mach' uns, deine Freunde, schwellen an Gewinn, Weisheit, Nachkommen und Besitz. Zum Heile möge ich, Gott Soma, deine Kelterung zu Ende führen."
translation_citation: W. Caland, Das Vaitanasutra des Atharvaveda, 1910

translation: With (the verse): "Who, (being) far away or near, hates us equal, foreign, or distant, may nothing of him be left over as from the fuel that is burnt down" he throws all the dead coals of the Āhāvaniya into (this fire). Then he mutters the triṣṭich (beginning): "Possessing cows, O Agni". Thereupon he addresses, standing, the Sun with (the verses): "From the darkness we have come to the light"; "This eye made by the Gods"; (and the formula): "May I not be cut off from seeing thee; what heat is thine, may I not be separated from that (heat) of thine". Then he makes a turn in the same manner (as described), turns from right to left, sits down and (paṛtakes) (of some) fresh milk—in case he is desirous of getting offspring—with (the verses): "May this sacrificial substance be productive for me, possessed of ten men, possessed of all the troops, for hail, self-winning, progeny-winning, safety-winning, cattle-winning, place-winning"; "May Agni raise for me abundant offspring. Bestow ye upon us food, milk and seed".

text_iast: adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vā annādīṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavaty annādo vai sa hotā bhavaty annādās te yajamānā bhavanti / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vā annapatnīṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavaty annapatir vai sa hotā bhavaty annapatayas te yajamānā bhavanti / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vai bhadrāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavati bhadraṃ vai tasmai hotre bhavati bhadraṃ tebhyo yajamānebhyo bhavati / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vai kalyāṇīṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavati kalyāṇaṃ vai tasmai hotre bhavati kalyāṇaṃ tebhyo yajamānebhyo bhavati / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vā anilayāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavaty anilayo vai sa hotā bhavaty anilayās te yajamānā bhavanti / adhvaryo yeṣām apabhayāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavaty abhayaṃ vai tasmai hotre bhavaty abhayaṃ tebhyo yajamānebhyo bhavati / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vā anāptāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavaty anāpto vai sa hotā bhavaty anāptās te yajamānā bhavanti / adhvaryo yeṣām anāpyāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvana hotā bhavaty anāpyo vai sa hotā bhavaty anāpyās te yajamānā bhavanti / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vā anādhṛṣṭāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavaty anādhṛṣṭo vai sa hotā bhavaty anādhṛṣṭās te yajamānā bhavanti / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vā anādhṛṣyāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavaty anādhṛṣyo vai sa hotā bhavaty anādhṛṣyās te yajamānā bhavanti / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vā apūrvāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavati na vai tasmād dhotur anyaḥ pūrvo bhavati na tebhyo yajamānebhyo 'nye pūrve bhavanti / adhvaryo yeṣāṃ vā abhrātṛvyāṃ prajāpates tanvaṃ vidvān hotā bhavaty abhrātṛvyo vai sa hotā bhavaty abhrātṛvyās te yajamānā bhavanti yeṣām evaṃvidvān hotā bhavatīti
translation: (1) "O adhvaryu, they who have as hotṛ one who knoweth the food-eating form of Prajāpati, that hotṛ becomes an eater of food and those sacrificers become eaters of food". (2) "O adhvaryu, they who have as hotṛ one who knoweth the lord of food form of Prajāpati, that hotṛ becomes a lord of food and those sacrificers become lords of food". (3) "O adhvaryu, they who have as hotṛ one who knoweth the fair form of Prajāpati, that hotṛ gets the fair thing and those sacrificers get the fair things". (4) "O adhvaryu, they who... beautiful form of Prajāpati... the beautiful..." (5) "O adhvaryu, they who....unresting form of Prajāpati..." (6) "O adhvaryu, they who... fearless form of Prajāpati... fearlessness gets..." (7) "O adhvaryu, they who... unattained..." (8) "O adhvaryu, they who... unattainable..." (9) "O adhvaryu, they who....unattacked...." (10) "O adhvaryu, they who...unattackable...." (11) "O adhvaryu, they who have as hotṛ one who knoweth the form of Prajāpati that has no prius, no other one comes prior to that adhvaryu, no other ones come prior to those sacrificers". (12) "O adhvaryu, they who have as their hotṛ one who knoweth the form of Prajāpati who has no rival, that hotṛ has no rival, no rivals have those sacrificers who have as hotṛ one who knows this".
